soe_package — Run a support-of-excavation wall analysis (cantilever, braced/anchored at support levels, or FHWA apparent-pressure anchored wall) and generate its calc package: earth pressures, embedment, moments and the strut or anchor loads, with tables (CSV + printed) of pressure, shear and moment along the wall.

ParameterTypeDescription
wall_typestroptionalThe excavation wall to analyse and report: 'cantilever' (the cantilever_excavation tool), 'braced' (braced_excavation: struts, rakers or anchors at given support levels) or 'fhwa_anchored' (fhwa_apparent_pressure_anchored_wall). allowed: cantilever, braced, fhwa_anchored
excavation_depthfloatoptionalRequired when wall_type is cantilever or braced. Excavation depth (m).
layersarrayoptionalRequired when wall_type is cantilever or braced. wall_type=cantilever: Array of soil-layer dicts, top down: {thickness (m, required), unit_weight (kN/m3, required), friction_angle (deg, default 30), cohesion (kPa, default 0), soil_type (optional and not read here: the cantilever analysis uses each layer's own phi and c; accepted so the same layers serve braced_excavation)}. The last layer continues below its thickness. | wall_type=braced: Array of soil-layer dicts, top down: {thickness (m, required), unit_weight (kN/m3, required), friction_angle (deg, default 30), cohesion (kPa, default 0), soil_type ('sand' or 'clay', also 'soft_clay' or 'stiff_clay'; REQUIRED on each layer above the excavation base, refused if missing)}. soil_type picks the Terzaghi-Peck apparent-pressure envelope: the one for sands where sand is the thicker over the excavation depth, else the one for clays, soft to medium or stiff fissured by the average N = gamma*H/cu over the excavation depth (> 4 soft). The embedment below the excavation uses each layer's own phi and c. The last layer continues below its thickness.
surchargefloatoptionalDefault: cantilever 10.0; braced 10.0; fhwa_anchored 0.0 (wall_type). wall_type=cantilever: Surface surcharge (kPa). | wall_type=braced: Surface surcharge (kPa); added to the envelope as Ka*q (sand) or q (clay). | wall_type=fhwa_anchored: Uniform surface surcharge q (kPa); adds ps = Ka*q.
gwt_depthfloatoptionalwall_type=cantilever: Groundwater depth behind the wall (m). | wall_type=braced: Groundwater depth behind the wall (m); water pressure is added for sand envelopes.
gwt_depth_excavationfloatoptionalGroundwater depth on the excavation side (m from top of wall), never above the excavation base. Default: same as gwt_depth.
FOS_passivefloatoptionalwall_type=cantilever: FOS on passive resistance. | wall_type=braced: Embedment FS, MR = FS*MD about the lowest support (Caltrans uses 1.3).
embedment_increasefloatoptionalDefault: cantilever 1.2; braced 1.0 (wall_type). wall_type=cantilever: D / D0 (Caltrans/AASHTO 1.2; use 1.0 to carry all safety on FOS_passive). | wall_type=braced: Multiplier on the free-earth-support embedment.
passive_theorystroptionalThe passive coefficient below the excavation: 'rankine' (default) = Rankine's Kp, no wall friction, as the Caltrans Trenching and Shoring Manual's examples take it where the wall friction is zero (pp. 7-18, 7-27), with its note that Rankine 'tends to underestimate the passive earth pressure' and Sec. 4-6 (p. 4-28): Rankine 'should not be used ... because it does not account for wall friction'; 'log_spiral' (or 'caquot_kerisel', the same) = the log-spiral Kp of log_spiral_source at passive_wall_friction_deg in each layer below the excavation. Choices give the other theory's Kp and embedment. allowed: rankine, log_spiral, caquot_kerisel
log_spiral_sourcestroptionalWith passive_theory 'log_spiral', the printed source of Kp, as earth_pressure_coefficient takes it: 'ufc_3_220_20' (default) = UFC 3-220-20 Eq. 4-12 (p. 191), its log-spiral Kp for a vertical face and level ground at any wall friction; 'caquot_kerisel_1948' = the Caltrans Trenching and Shoring Manual Fig. 4-20 chart (its Example 8-1), and 'dm7_2_eq_4_12' = UFC Eq. 4-12 by name, both needing passive_wall_friction_deg given; 'dm7_2_fig_4_12' / 'dm7_2_fig_4_13' = UFC's charts, drawn for delta/phi' 0.66 only. allowed: ufc_3_220_20, caquot_kerisel_1948, dm7_2_eq_4_12, dm7_2_fig_4_12, dm7_2_fig_4_13
passive_wall_friction_degfloatoptionalWith passive_theory 'log_spiral', the wall friction delta (deg) in every layer below the excavation, at most its phi': the engineer's call (UFC 3-220-20 Table 4-1, p. 184; Caltrans Example 8-1 takes 15 deg on phi 30). Left out: delta/phi' = 0.66 (UFC p. 191, 'a common assumption') in a layer without cohesion, none in a layer with cohesion (UFC Fig. 4-37 step 1, p. 237: 'Passive pressures for clean coarse grained soils include wall friction'; in other soils it ignores wall friction); refused with 'caquot_kerisel_1948' or 'dm7_2_eq_4_12', which need it given (Caltrans p. 4-29: 'Given delta'). For soldier piles in coarse-grained soil UFC p. 249 takes KP 'without wall friction': give 0.
FyfloatoptionalSteel yield strength (MPa) for section sizing.
supportsarrayoptionalSupport levels [{depth (m), support_type ('strut' or 'anchor'), spacing (m), angle_deg}].
HfloatoptionalRequired when wall_type is fhwa_anchored. Total wall height (m).
anchor_depthsarrayoptionalRequired when wall_type is fhwa_anchored. Depths of the anchor levels below the top of wall (m), e.g. [2.5, 6.25].
gammafloatoptionalRequired when wall_type is fhwa_anchored. Retained-soil unit weight (kN/m3).
phifloatoptionalRequired when wall_type is fhwa_anchored. Retained-soil friction angle (deg).
spacingfloatoptionalHorizontal anchor spacing (m) for the design loads.
inclination_degfloatoptionalAnchor inclination from horizontal (deg).
KafloatoptionalActive coefficient override (default Rankine Ka).
KpfloatoptionalSingle anchor only (refused with two or more anchors): passive coefficient below the excavation (default Rankine; pass a log-spiral value).
FOS_embedmentfloatoptionalSingle anchor only (refused with two or more anchors): embedment FS, MR = FS*MD about the anchor (Caltrans T&S Manual Sec. 8-4).
project_namestroptionalProject name for header.
project_numberstroptionalProject number for header.
engineerstroptionalEngineer name for header.
checkerstroptionalChecker name for header.
companystroptionalCompany name for header.
datestroptionalDate string (auto-filled if empty).
assumptionsdictoptionalThe inputs you pass that the user did not give, as {input name: its basis}, e.g. {"unit_weight": "not given; typical of the soil described"}. An assumption that is not an input is its own row: {"drained": "long-term condition"}. The package lists them under Assumed Inputs with the analysis's own defaults, so no assumption reads as given. A misspelt input name is refused with a did-you-mean.
givenlist|dictoptionalThe inputs you pass that the user gave, by the names you pass them under, e.g. ["width", "depth", "friction_angle"], or with the user's own words, {"friction_angle": "phi 32 deg from the boring logs"}. Only these print under Given Inputs. Every other input you pass prints under Assumed Inputs as passed, not stated as given (with its basis when it is in assumptions); left out, no input is the user's. A value you read off, worked out or chose is assumed, not given.
output_pathstroptionalFile path to save output. Auto-generated if omitted.
formatstroptionalOutput format: 'html' (recommended, self-contained with embedded CSS), 'latex' (raw .tex source), or 'pdf' (requires pdflatex installed). HTML is always available; PDF requires a LaTeX compiler on the system. allowed: html, latex, pdf

reliability_package — Run a reliability analysis (FOSM, point estimates, Monte Carlo or FORM) on a performance function of random variables and generate its calc package: the variables and their distributions, the moments of g, the reliability index beta and the probability of failure, and which variable matters.

ParameterTypeDescription
enginestroptionalWhich reliability engine to run and report: 'fosm' (Taylor series), 'pem' (Rosenblueth point estimates), 'monte_carlo' or 'form' (the tool of that name). allowed: fosm, pem, monte_carlo, form
variablesobjectrequiredRandom variables: {name: {mean, cov or std, dist, lower, upper}}. dist one of ['normal', 'lognormal', 'uniform', 'triangular'] (default normal). lower/upper truncate normal/lognormal or bound uniform/triangular. Example: {'su': {'mean': 50, 'cov': 0.3, 'dist': 'lognormal'}}.
g_expressionstrrequiredPerformance function of the variable names. With convention='fos' write a FACTOR OF SAFETY (failure at g<1), e.g. 'R/S'; with 'margin' a margin (failure at g<0), e.g. 'R - S'. Math functions allowed (sqrt, log, exp, tan, radians, ...).
conventionstroptional'fos': g is a factor of safety (failure g<1, lognormal beta reported). 'margin': g = R-S (failure g<0). allowed: fos, margin
correlationobjectoptionalPairwise correlations {'a,b': rho} or full matrix [[...]] in variable order. Omit for independent variables.
schemestroptional'full' = 2^n points; 'multiplicative' = Rosenblueth 2n+1 (uncorrelated only). allowed: full, multiplicative
nintoptionalRealizations. Aim n >= 10/pf.
seedintoptionalRNG seed for reproducibility.
samplingstroptional'lhs' = Latin Hypercube (variance reduction). allowed: random, lhs
n_binsintoptionalHistogram bins.
max_iterationsintoptionalHL-RF iteration cap.
project_namestroptionalProject name for header.
project_numberstroptionalProject number for header.
engineerstroptionalEngineer name for header.
checkerstroptionalChecker name for header.
companystroptionalCompany name for header.
datestroptionalDate string (auto-filled if empty).
assumptionsdictoptionalThe inputs you pass that the user did not give, as {input name: its basis}, e.g. {"unit_weight": "not given; typical of the soil described"}. An assumption that is not an input is its own row: {"drained": "long-term condition"}. The package lists them under Assumed Inputs with the analysis's own defaults, so no assumption reads as given. A misspelt input name is refused with a did-you-mean.
givenlist|dictoptionalThe inputs you pass that the user gave, by the names you pass them under, e.g. ["width", "depth", "friction_angle"], or with the user's own words, {"friction_angle": "phi 32 deg from the boring logs"}. Only these print under Given Inputs. Every other input you pass prints under Assumed Inputs as passed, not stated as given (with its basis when it is in assumptions); left out, no input is the user's. A value you read off, worked out or chose is assumed, not given.
output_pathstroptionalFile path to save output. Auto-generated if omitted.
formatstroptionalOutput format: 'html' (recommended, self-contained with embedded CSS), 'latex' (raw .tex source), or 'pdf' (requires pdflatex installed). HTML is always available; PDF requires a LaTeX compiler on the system. allowed: html, latex, pdf

ParameterTypeDescription
sectionsfloatrequiredOne dict per bore-hole/section, each with:

retrieve_section — Retrieve one section by its ID, at any level: its own text, 'under' (the sections above it) and 'children' (ID and title of each subsection, fetched by its own ID). A missing ID's error names the nearest section above it and the sections numbered under it.

ParameterTypeDescription
section_idstrrequiredSection identifier at any level (e.g. '1', '1.1', '2.1.1').
include_subsectionsbooloptionalInline the subsections' text too, when the whole fits in 12,000 characters; otherwise they stay listed in 'children' with a note.

search_sections — Keyword search across every section and subsection, best first: each hit is a section's number, title, chapter, 'under' (the sections above it) and a snippet of its text, never the whole text (retrieve_section fetches that). As many hits as fit; 'next_offset' and a note say how to get more.

ParameterTypeDescription
querystrrequiredSearch query (case-insensitive, multi-word AND).
limitintoptionalMost hits to return (at most 50; fewer when they would not fit).
offsetintoptionalSkip this many of the best hits: the 'next_offset' of the last call.

list_chapters — List chapters and their sections by ID and title, subsections included (a nested one carries parent_id). Without 'chapter': every chapter, with its sections when the whole listing fits one result (otherwise titles and section counts, and a note). With 'chapter': that chapter's sections.

ParameterTypeDescription
chapterintoptionalChapter number: list its sections. Leave out for every chapter.

load_chapter — Load a whole chapter: every section's text. A chapter too long for one result (most are) comes back as its list of sections with a note: fetch the ones you need with retrieve_section.

ParameterTypeDescription
chapterintrequiredChapter number.

10.1.34 drawing_ir — drawing_ir

digitize_drawing — Digitize a drawing (DXF / PDF-vector / raster image) into a unified intermediate representation. Caches the IR server-side under a 'handle' and returns a summary + stats (counts by type/layer, page metadata, extent, scale). Then use query_drawing / get_entities — the full IR is never returned by default.

ParameterTypeDescription
file_pathstrrequiredPath to the drawing file (.dxf, .pdf, or a raster image).
sourcestroptionalIngest leg. 'auto' picks by file extension. allowed: auto, dxf, pdf_vector, raster
pageintoptionalPDF page (0-indexed); pdf_vector only.
scalefloatoptionalModel units per page/drawing unit (m per PDF point, or m per pixel for raster). Promotes coordinates to model space (meters). Omit to stay in page/pixel units.
unitsstroptionalDXF drawing units override (default: the DXF $INSUNITS header, else meters). dxf only. allowed: m, mm, cm, ft, in
explode_blocksbooloptionalDXF only: explode block references (INSERTs) into IR primitives tagged style='block:<NAME>'. Default true — most annotation line-work on a real sheet is stamped from blocks and is otherwise invisible (n_block_entities reports how many entities came from blocks). Set false to see ONLY geometry drawn directly in model space, e.g. when a stamped title-block border outranks the section line-work you asked about.
originstroptionalY-orientation for PDF/raster (bottom_left = engineering up-positive). allowed: bottom_left, top_left
calibrationdictoptionalTwo-point PDF scale calibration {p1:[x,y], p2:[x,y], distance_m}. Alternative to scale.
detect_linesbooloptionalRaster: detect straight segments (Hough).
detect_circlesbooloptionalRaster: detect circles (Hough gradient).
detect_contoursbooloptionalRaster: trace closed shapes (contours). May overlap Hough lines on line-work.
ocrbooloptionalRaster: attempt OCR text (needs pytesseract + Tesseract; skipped with a warning if absent).
ocr_textbooloptionalPDF only: additionally OCR the rendered page and merge recognized text into the IR as confidence<1 text entities (source='ocr'). THE way to read SHX/stroked-lettering sheets (has_text=false) — needs planlens[ocr] (RapidOCR; auto-detects sideways plots). Adds seconds to a-minute-ish per page. SKIPPED, with a reason in the result, when the page already carries vector text: that text is exact and OCR could only add noisier copies. Check has_text/n_text in the summary first.
ocr_forcebooloptionalRun the OCR pass even though the page already has a text layer (e.g. a sheet that is part vector text, part scanned inset). Expensive: a large sheet is a many-megapixel render, so prefer snipping the region and OCRing that.

query_drawing — Request a SLICE of a cached drawing IR by handle. Returns compact entity references (id + small summary), not full coordinate dumps — follow up with get_entities for exact coordinates of a shortlist.

ParameterTypeDescription
handlestrrequiredHandle from digitize_drawing.
querystrrequiredWhich slice to compute. allowed: candidate_ground_surface, entities_by_color, entities_ending_near, entities_in_bbox, entities_on_layer, find_bubble_callouts, find_dimensions, find_leaders, find_revision_clouds, find_title_block, horizontal_lines, lines_by_angle, nearest_entity, polylines_longer_than, summary_stats, text_anchored_geometry, text_items, text_near, vertical_lines
paramsdictoptionalQuery params. entities_in_bbox: {x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max,mode?,entity_type?}; nearest_entity: {x,y,entity_type?,k?}; lines_by_angle: {min_deg,max_deg}; horizontal_lines/vertical_lines: {tol_deg?}; polylines_longer_than: {min_length}; text_items: {pattern?}; text_near: {entity_id,radius}; entities_ending_near: {x,y,radius,entity_types?} (what TERMINATES at a point — arrow tips, callout tails); text_anchored_geometry: {pattern,radius?,entity_types?} (find text X -> geometry ending at it -> the far point it points at; pattern is any runtime string); find_leaders: {min_confidence?,exclude_dimensions?,...}; find_dimensions/find_title_block/find_bubble_callouts/find_revision_clouds: {min_confidence?,...} (annotation-construct PROPOSALS with confidence + evidence — never asserted facts; confirm visually). On no-text-layer (SHX-stroked) sheets find_dimensions detects real plotted dims (split-shaft + continuous legs, 16/16 native defpoints on validation sheets; ends = arrow apexes) but some high-confidence hits may be other line-plus-arrows constructs — verify via snip_region before reporting values; entities_on_layer: {layer}; entities_by_color: {color}; candidate_ground_surface: {} — widest-horizontal-extent PROPOSAL; on a DXF digitized with the default explode_blocks=true it ranks over stamped block line-work too, so a title-block border can out-rank the drawn section surface (the reply echoes n_block_entities when the IR has any) — re-digitize with explode_blocks=false to rank over only directly drawn model-space work; summary_stats: {}.

get_entities — Fetch full, exact coordinates for specific entity ids from a cached drawing IR (the deterministic coordinates the LLM should trust over its own pixel reading).

ParameterTypeDescription
handlestrrequiredHandle from digitize_drawing.
idsarrayrequiredEntity ids to retrieve (e.g. ['e0','e5']).

snip_region — Render a zoomed-in crop of a PDF drawing page to a PNG file — the 'geometry says WHERE, vision says WHAT' primitive. Feed exact coordinates from query_drawing (e.g. a leader's tip_xy, a title block's region_bbox), then analyze the saved PNG with analyze_image (or use the one-step render_region tool).

ParameterTypeDescription
file_pathstrrequiredPath to the source PDF.
output_pathstrrequiredWhere to save the PNG crop.
pageintoptionalPDF page (0-indexed).
bboxarrayoptional[x0,y0,x1,y1] region of interest. Omit for the full page.
framestroptionalCoordinate frame of bbox/marks: 'ir' (bottom-left origin, y up — what digitize_drawing/query_drawing return, the default) or 'pdf' (top-left points, y down). allowed: ir, pdf
scalefloatoptionalModel units per PDF point, ONLY if the drawing was digitized with a scale (model-space IR coords are divided by this before the flip).
dpiintoptionalRender resolution.
pad_fracfloatoptionalFractional padding around bbox.
marksarrayoptional[[x,y,label], ...] numbered marker circles drawn at points of interest (set-of-marks: 'what is mark 1 pointing at?'). Same frame as bbox.

search_drawing_set — Search EVERY page of one or more drawing files (PDF/DXF) in one call: count/locate text matches ('how many times does X occur in this set') or annotation constructs (leaders, dimensions, title_block, bubble_callouts, revision_clouds — confidence-scored proposals). Returns per-file, per-page counts + compact match locations. Digitized pages are cached across calls (first pass on a dense sheet can take seconds).

ParameterTypeDescription
file_pathsarrayrequiredOne path or a list of paths (.pdf or .dxf).
patternstroptionalText to find (regex, else literal substring; case-insensitive). Any runtime string. With 'construct', filters constructs by their text (title blocks: matched against all contained text; revision clouds carry no text and never match a pattern). NOTE: sheets plotted with SHX/stroked lettering have NO text layer — such pages are flagged no_text_layer and a zero count is inconclusive; pass ocr_text=true to read them optically.
ocr_textbooloptionalOCR pages that have no text layer before the pattern search (planlens[ocr]; adds seconds per no-text page, cached across calls).
constructstroptionalAnnotation construct to search for instead of (or as well as) raw text. allowed: leaders, dimensions, title_block, bubble_callouts, revision_clouds
pagesarrayoptionalPage numbers (0-indexed) to search; omit for ALL pages of each file.
min_confidencefloatoptionalConstruct proposals below this are dropped.

earthquake_load_combination — Eq 3-3/3-4/3-5: earthquake load combinations (printed p. 26).

ParameterTypeDescription

earthquake_load_combination — Eq 4.7/4.8/4.9: earthquake load combinations (printed p. 32).

permanent_sumfloatrequiredsum(gamma_p * Lp), the factored permanent-load sum (see `load_combination_lrfd`'s permanent_sum, or compute directly).
eq_loadfloatrequiredEQ, the earthquake load effect (unfactored).
companion_termsfloatoptionalCompanion loads (typically hydrostatic, Hsc).
methodfloatoptional'standard_obe' (Eq 4.7, U = sum(gamma_p*Lp) + 1.5*EQ + gamma_c*Ltc, for the OBE/unusual-return-period standard ground motion, default), 'standard_mde' (Eq 4.8, U = sum(gamma_p*Lp) + 1.25*EQ + gamma_c*Ltc, for standard MDE ground motion -- Table 4.1 footnote 6's "1.25"), or 'site_specific' (Eq 4.9, U = sum(gamma_p*Lp) + 1.0*EQ + 1.0*Lt, for site-specific MDE/MCE ground motion -- Table 4.1 footnote 6's "1.0"; unfactored because a site-specific analysis already reflects the target reliability).

fatigue_serviceability_load_factor — Table 4.1's Serviceability-and-Fatigue column: 1.0 for every load (footnote 5: this is the FINITE fatigue life value; infinite-life fatigue design uses 2.0 for all loads -- see `fatigue_fracture.fatigue_load_factor`). Printed p. 27.

ParameterTypeDescription
load_idfloatrequired

load_combination_lrfd — Eq 4.2: general LRFD load-combination equation (printed p. 23).

ParameterTypeDescription
permanent_termsfloatrequiredPermanent-load contributions Lp with their Table 4.1 gamma_p (`table_4_1_permanent_load_factor`).
principal_termfloatrequiredThe single principal load Lpr with its Table 4.1 or paragraph-4.3.4 principal load factor.
companion_termsfloatoptionalTemporary and/or dynamic companion-load contributions (Ltc, Ldc).

performance_factor — Paragraph 4.1.1: the HSS performance factor alpha, applied to AISC resistance factors (printed p. 17).

ParameterTypeDescription
overridefloatoptional

principal_load_condition_factor — Paragraph 4.3.4: generic principal load factor gamma_pr for a load not covered by a specific Table 4.1 row (printed pp. 24-25).

ParameterTypeDescription
conditionfloatrequiredA key of `PRINCIPAL_LOAD_CONDITIONS`: 'condition_1' (maximum loading not limited by geometry/physical factors, e.g. wind/wave, return period estimable -- 1.2), 'condition_2_usual'/'condition_2_unusual'/'condition_2_extreme' (loading limited to a maximum value with a return period in the stated range -- 1.5/1.4/1.3), or 'condition_3' (return period unknown; treated as very-low- probability-of-exceedance extreme -- 1.3).

principal_load_factor_self_straining — Paragraph 4.3.4.4: self-straining (T) principal load factor, gamma_pr = 1.2 (min) (printed p. 25).

ParameterTypeDescription
minimumfloatoptional

required_strength_check — Eq 4.1: sum(gamma_i * Qni) <= alpha*phi*Rn, the basic LRFD safety check (printed p. 17).

ParameterTypeDescription
u_demandfloatrequiredU = sum(gamma_i * Qni), the factored-load demand (from `load_combination_lrfd` or an earthquake combination).
phifloatrequiredAISC resistance factor for the limit state (paragraph 4.1: "These are provided in AISC, except the resistance factor for forged and cast materials, which is 0.7").
rn_nominalfloatrequiredNominal resistance per AISC.
alphafloatoptionalPerformance factor (`performance_factor`); default 1.0.

table_4_1_load_factor — Table 4.1 principal/companion load factor for a temporary or dynamic load (printed p. 27).

ParameterTypeDescription
load_idfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_4_1_TEMPORARY_DYNAMIC` (e.g. 'Hs', 'Hw', 'EQ').
categoryfloatrequired'usual', 'unusual', or 'extreme' (ignored if role='companion').
rolefloatoptional'principal' (default; the usual/unusual/extreme column) or 'companion' (the Permanent-and-Companion column, gamma_c).

table_4_1_permanent_load_factor — Table 4.1 permanent load factor gamma_p (printed p. 27).

ParameterTypeDescription
load_idfloatrequired'D' or 'G'.
effectfloatoptional'add' (loads add to the predominant effect, default), 'subtract', or 'alone' (D used alone as a principal load, gamma_pr = 1.4; 'D' only).

amplification_factor — Eq D.10: the amplification factor A(z) = ac / PGA, normalized form (printed p. 399).

ParameterTypeDescription
safloatrequired
gamma_tildefloatrequired
pgafloatrequired
zfloatrequired
hsfloatrequired

dam_period_estimate — Eq D.11/D.12 (Chopra & Tan 1989, as simplified in Appendix D): an estimate of the dam's fundamental period, for use with a period-based (rather than peak-spectral-acceleration) evaluation of Eq D.8 (printed p. 401).

ParameterTypeDescription
hsfloatrequiredDam height, ft.
esfloatrequiredModulus of elasticity of the dam concrete, psi.

hss_support_acceleration — Eq 4.6 (= Eq D.8): HSS support acceleration ac via the pseudo-dynamic (Chopra & Tan 1989) amplification method (printed p. 32 / p. 400). This is the validated closed form -- see module docstring item 2 for why the "C = 0.75" factor in Eq 4.4 is NOT applied here.

ParameterTypeDescription
safloatrequiredSpectral acceleration SA(T1, zeta) at the structure's period and damping ratio, g (from a site response spectrum; damping typically assumed 5%, paragraph D.2.5).
gamma_tildefloatrequiredScale factor (`table_4_2_scale_factor`, or 2.8 for gravity dams per Appendix D's general recommendation, printed p. 398).
pgafloatrequiredPeak ground acceleration, g.
zfloatrequiredHeight of the HSS above the dam foundation.
hsfloatrequiredFull dam height.

hss_support_acceleration_with_c_factor — Eq 4.4: HSS support acceleration ac WITH the printed "Pseudo Static Correction Factor" C (printed p. 30). See module docstring item 2 -- this literal form of Eq 4.4 is NOT what the Appendix D worked example (nor Eq 4.6) actually computes; provided for traceability to the as-printed equation only.

ParameterTypeDescription
safloatrequired
gamma_tildefloatrequired
pgafloatrequired
zfloatrequired
hsfloatrequired
cfloatoptionalPseudo Static Correction Factor; printed value 0.75 (default). (other parameters as `hss_support_acceleration`)

mode_shape_phi — Eq 4.5 (= Eq D.9): the fundamental mode shape phi(z) for a concrete gravity dam, found by Chopra & Tan (1989) to represent gravity dams of varying heights well enough that a single shape suffices (printed p. 32 / p. 398).

ParameterTypeDescription
zfloatrequiredHeight of the HSS (e.g. trunnion) above the dam foundation.
hsfloatrequiredFull dam height (foundation to crest).

table_4_2_scale_factor — Table 4.2: scale factor Gamma-tilde by dam height-to-width ratio (printed p. 31). See the module docstring, item 1, for the "Equation 4.7" citation printed in this table -- it is reproduced here verbatim for traceability, but the actual computation is Eq 4.4/4.6 (Appendix D Eq D.8), implemented in `hss_support_acceleration`.

ParameterTypeDescription
height_to_width_categoryfloatrequired'gt_1h_1.5w' (height/width ratio greater than 1h:1.5w -- tall, heavily tapered dams; Gamma-tilde = 2.8), '1h_1.5w_to_1h_3w' (intermediate; Gamma-tilde = 1.5), or 'lt_1h_3w' (wide, low-taper dams; use PGA directly, i.e. no amplification -- amplification factor A(z) = 1.0).

table_d1_measured_amplification — Table D.1: measured base-to-crest acceleration amplification factors at nine instrumented concrete gravity dams (printed p. 389). Background context motivating the simplified method -- not a design formula.

ParameterTypeDescription
damfloatoptionalA key of `TABLE_D_1_MEASURED_AMPLIFICATION`. If omitted, the full table is returned.

westergaard_pressure — Eq 4.3: Westergaard (1933) hydrodynamic pressure at depth y below the pool surface, for simplified seismic screening (printed p. 28).

ParameterTypeDescription
gamma_wfloatrequiredUnit weight of water.
acfloatrequiredMaximum acceleration at the HSS support in the upstream/downstream direction, as a fraction of g (`hss_support_acceleration`).
hfloatrequiredPool depth to dam foundation.
yfloatrequiredDistance below the pool surface.

fatigue_check_required — Paragraph 5.1.3: fatigue-life screening rule (printed p. 34).

ParameterTypeDescription
dead_load_compressive_stressfloatrequiredSustained (dead-load) compressive stress at the detail, taken positive.
live_load_tensile_stressfloatrequiredLive-load-induced tensile stress at the same detail, taken positive.

fatigue_load_factor — Table 4.1 footnote 5: the load factor applied to loads used to compute fatigue stress (printed p. 27; also paragraph 5.1.1.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
lifefloatoptional'finite' (default) or 'infinite'.

fracture_critical_redundancy_check — Paragraph 5.2.1.2: the refined-analysis strength check used to show a member need not be treated as fracture critical because the structure retains adequate strength/stability with that member assumed fractured (printed p. 35).

ParameterTypeDescription
q_demand_unfactored_sumfloatrequiredSum of all applicable UNFACTORED load effects (gamma = 1.0 applied to each), consistent units with rn_nominal.
rn_nominalfloatrequiredNominal strength for the applicable limit state (phi = 1.0 applied).
fyfloatrequiredMaterial yield strength (for the 90%-of-yield stress cap; pass the governing stress alongside fy via the caller's own stress computation if q_demand_unfactored_sum is a force rather than a stress -- this function's stress check assumes q_demand_unfactored_sum is already expressed as a stress when used for the 0.90*Fy cap).

bolt_grade_check — Paragraph 6.1.3.4/6.1.3.10: allowed bolt grades by application (printed pp. 38, 41).

ParameterTypeDescription
gradefloatrequiredA bolt grade designation (matched case-insensitively against `STRUCTURAL_BOLT_GRADES/NONSTRUCTURAL_BOLT_GRADES`).
applicationfloatoptional'structural' (default) or 'nonstructural'.

faying_surface_class — Paragraph 6.1.3.8.2: AISC/RCSC S348 faying-surface classification as referenced in this manual (printed p. 39). This manual gives no numeric slip coefficient for either class -- see AISC 360/RCSC S348 directly; it only notes that clean mill scale and blast-cleaned steel qualify as Class A/B respectively, and recommends priming connection faying surfaces for HSS corrosion protection regardless (with a qualified slip- critical primer, since vinyl paint alone does not qualify, paragraph 6.1.3.8).

ParameterTypeDescription
surface_conditionfloatrequired'clean_mill_scale' or 'blast_cleaned'.

welding_code_selection — Paragraph 6.1.2.1: welding code selection (printed p. 38).

ParameterTypeDescription
cyclically_loaded_or_fcmfloatrequiredTrue if the member is cyclically loaded or is a Fracture Critical Member.

anchorage_shear_friction_check — Eq 10.15: shear-friction check for a post-tensioned trunnion-girder anchorage interface (printed p. 166).

ParameterTypeDescription
vufloatrequiredFactored shear force at the girder/pier interface.
mufloatrequiredCoefficient of friction for the interface.
rfloatrequiredResidual compressive (post-tensioning) force between the girder and pier.

girder_deflection_limit — Paragraph 10.8.1: maximum girder deflection (printed p. 152).

ParameterTypeDescription
lengthfloatrequiredGirder span (between end frames) or cantilever length.
cantileverfloatoptionalTrue for the cantilever-portion limit (L/300); False (default) for the between-end-frames limit (L/800).

hydrostatic_horizontal_component — Eq F.10: horizontal component of the radial hydrostatic force (printed p. 427; see module docstring for the sign correction applied).

ParameterTypeDescription
rfloatrequired
gamma_wfloatrequired
yfloatrequired
theta1floatrequired
theta2floatrequired

hydrostatic_moment — Eq F.12/F.13: moment of the radial hydrostatic force about the trunnion-pin centerline (printed p. 427-428). Both the horizontal- and vertical-component moments (Mh, Mv) reduce to the SAME closed form (the manual notes, printed p. 441, that they must be identical because the moment of the hydrostatic head about the trunnion pin is zero).

ParameterTypeDescription
rfloatrequired
gamma_wfloatrequired
yfloatrequired
theta1floatrequired
theta2floatrequired

ParameterTypeDescription

gamma_wfloatrequiredUnit weight of water, kcf.

theta1floatrequired
theta2floatrequired

ParameterTypeDescription

phfloatrequired
mvfloatrequired
pvfloatrequired

hydrostatic_simplified_projection — Eq F.16: simplified horizontal hydrostatic force by projecting the load onto a vertical plane, applicable when the water surface is at or below the top of the skin plate (printed p. 429).

ParameterTypeDescription

el_trunnionfloatoptional
el_sillfloatoptional

ParameterTypeDescription
rfloatrequired
gamma_wfloatrequired
yfloatrequired
theta1floatrequired
theta2floatrequired

No parameters.

minimum_barge_impact_load — Paragraph 10.2.5: minimum design barge-impact load for Tainter gates on navigable waterways (printed p. 144).

ParameterTypeDescription

minimum_rib_depth — Paragraph 10.12.3: minimum rib depth, typically 8 in. (shorter clearances usable if adequate weld quality can be demonstrated), printed p. 157.

No parameters.

nominal_friction_coefficients — Paragraph 10.2.11: nominal coefficients of friction, side seal and trunnion (values confirmed via the Appendix E worked example, printed p. 414, which cites paragraph 10.2.11 directly).

No parameters.

resultant_angle_from_horizontal — The radial-force resultant angle from horizontal, theta_p (printed p. 427/440). See the module docstring: this implements atan(Pv/Ph), the form the worked example (printed p. 440) actually computes, not the atan(Ph/Pv) implied by the surrounding narrative text.

ParameterTypeDescription
phfloatrequired
pvfloatrequired

seal_preset_force — Eq F.1: force per unit length induced by presetting the side seal (printed p. 420).

ParameterTypeDescription
deltafloatrequiredSeal preset distance, in.

i_sealfloatrequiredSeal moment of inertia per foot of seal length, in^4/ft (= t^3 for thickness t, unit foot width).
d1floatrequiredLength (width) of seal exposed to the preset deflection, in.

side_seal_friction_force — Eq 10.1 (= F.1-F.3 combined): total side-seal friction force on a Tainter gate (printed p. 144).

ParameterTypeDescription

No parameters.

ParameterTypeDescription
rtxfloatrequired
rtyfloatrequired

retrieve_section — Retrieve one section by its ID, at any level: its own text, 'under' (the sections above it) and 'children' (ID and title of each subsection, fetched by its own ID). A missing ID's error names the nearest section above it and the sections numbered under it.

ParameterTypeDescription
section_idstrrequiredSection identifier at any level (e.g. '1.1').
include_subsectionsbooloptionalInline the subsections' text too, when the whole fits in 12,000 characters; otherwise they stay listed in 'children' with a note.

search_sections — Keyword search across every section and subsection, best first: each hit is a section's number, title, chapter, 'under' (the sections above it) and a snippet of its text, never the whole text (retrieve_section fetches that). As many hits as fit; 'next_offset' and a note say how to get more.

ParameterTypeDescription
querystrrequiredSearch query (case-insensitive, multi-word AND).
limitintoptionalMost hits to return (at most 50; fewer when they would not fit).
offsetintoptionalSkip this many of the best hits: the 'next_offset' of the last call.

list_chapters — List chapters and their sections by ID and title, subsections included (a nested one carries parent_id). Without 'chapter': every chapter, with its sections when the whole listing fits one result (otherwise titles and section counts, and a note). With 'chapter': that chapter's sections.

ParameterTypeDescription
chapterintoptionalChapter number: list its sections. Leave out for every chapter.

load_chapter — Load a whole chapter: every section's text. A chapter too long for one result (most are) comes back as its list of sections with a note: fetch the ones you need with retrieve_section.

ParameterTypeDescription
chapterintrequiredChapter number.

resistancestroptional'bearing' (gamma_R;v), 'sliding' (gamma_R;h), or 'earth_resistance' (gamma_R;e).

bearing_capacity_factors — Drained bearing capacity factors Nq, Nc, Ngamma (Eq. D.2, Annex D.4).

ParameterTypeDescription
phi_degfloatrequiredDesign effective angle of shearing resistance, phi' [degrees]. Must be > 0.

cohesion_earth_pressure_coefficient — Cohesion earth-pressure coefficient Kac (Eq. C.1 note, pdf idx 142).

ParameterTypeDescription
KfloatrequiredThe corresponding earth-pressure coefficient (Ka for Kac, or Kp by analogy for Kpc).
adhesionfloatrequiredAdhesion between ground and wall, a [kPa].
cohesionfloatrequiredCohesion, c (c' or cu) [kPa]. Must be > 0.

drained_bearing_resistance — Design bearing resistance in drained conditions (Eq. D.2, Annex D.4).

ParameterTypeDescription
phi_degfloatrequiredDesign effective angle of shearing resistance, phi' [degrees].
cfloatrequiredDesign effective cohesion, c' [kPa].
qfloatrequiredDesign effective overburden pressure at the foundation base level [kPa].
gammafloatrequiredDesign effective weight density of the soil below the foundation [kN/m3].
BfloatrequiredEffective foundation width B' [m].
LfloatoptionalEffective foundation length L' [m]. Omit for a square/circular base.
shapestroptional'rectangular' or 'square_circular'. If L is omitted, defaults to 'square_circular'.
alpha_degfloatoptionalInclination of the foundation base to the horizontal [degrees]. Default 0.
HfloatoptionalDesign horizontal load [kN], acting in the direction given by `load_direction`. Default 0 (no inclination factors reduction, i=1).
VfloatoptionalDesign vertical load [kN]. Required if H != 0.
load_directionstroptional'B' (H acts in the direction of B') or 'L' (H acts in the direction of L'). Selects m = mB or m = mL. Default 'B'.
A_primefloatoptionalDesign effective foundation area A' = B'*L' [m2]. If omitted, computed as B*L (or B*B for square/circular).

mobilised_wall_angle_mw — Angle mw from the wall boundary condition (Eq. C.4, pdf idx 152).

ParameterTypeDescription
phi_degfloatrequiredAngle of shearing resistance [degrees]; negative for active-pressure calculations per Annex C.2(3).
delta_degfloatrequiredAngle of wall friction [degrees]; negative for active-pressure calculations per Annex C.2(3).

passive_earth_pressure — Total passive earth pressure normal to a wall at depth z (Eq. C.2).

ParameterTypeDescription
K_pfloatrequiredCoefficient of effective horizontal passive earth pressure (from Figures C.2.1-C.2.4, or an external analytical/numerical method).
gammafloatrequired
depthfloatrequired
qfloatoptional
ufloatoptional
cfloatoptional
K_pcfloatoptionalCohesion earth-pressure coefficient (see `cohesion_earth_pressure_coefficient`). Default 0.

pressuremeter_bearing_resistance — Design bearing resistance from pressuremeter test results (Annex E).

ParameterTypeDescription
sigma_v0floatrequiredInitial total vertical stress at the foundation base level [kPa].
kfloatrequiredBearing resistance factor, typically in the range 0.8 to 3.0 depending on soil type, embedment depth, and foundation shape (Annex E(3)).
p_le_starfloatrequiredDesign net equivalent limit pressure from the pressuremeter test [kPa].

undrained_bearing_resistance — Design bearing resistance in undrained conditions (Eq. D.1, Annex D.3).

ParameterTypeDescription
cufloatrequiredDesign undrained shear strength [kPa].
qfloatrequiredDesign effective overburden pressure at the foundation base level [kPa].
BfloatrequiredEffective foundation width B' [m].
LfloatoptionalEffective foundation length L' [m]. Omit (or set equal to B) for a square or circular base (uses the sc=1.2 special case).
shapestroptional'rectangular' or 'square_circular'. If L is omitted, defaults to 'square_circular'.
alpha_degfloatoptionalInclination of the foundation base to the horizontal, alpha [degrees]. Default 0 (horizontal base).
HfloatoptionalDesign horizontal load [kN]. Must satisfy H <= A'*cu. Default 0.
A_primefloatoptionalDesign effective foundation area A' = B'*L' [m2]. If omitted, computed as B*L (or B*B for square/circular).

weight_density_coefficient — Approximate weight-density earth-pressure coefficient Kgamma (Eq. C.9, pdf idx 153).

ParameterTypeDescription
K_nfloatrequiredCoefficient for normal loading on the surface (Eq. C.6 -- must be supplied by the caller; not computed by this module, see the module docstring).
beta_degfloatrequiredSlope angle of the ground behind the wall, positive rising away from the wall [degrees].
theta_degfloatoptionalAngle between the vertical and the wall direction, positive when the soil overhangs the wall [degrees]. Default 0 (vertical wall).

retrieve_section — Retrieve one section by its ID, at any level: its own text, 'under' (the sections above it) and 'children' (ID and title of each subsection, fetched by its own ID). A missing ID's error names the nearest section above it and the sections numbered under it.

ParameterTypeDescription
section_idstrrequiredSection identifier at any level (e.g. '1.2', '2.4.5.1', '2.4.7.3.4.1').
include_subsectionsbooloptionalInline the subsections' text too, when the whole fits in 12,000 characters; otherwise they stay listed in 'children' with a note.

search_sections — Keyword search across every section and subsection, best first: each hit is a section's number, title, chapter, 'under' (the sections above it) and a snippet of its text, never the whole text (retrieve_section fetches that). As many hits as fit; 'next_offset' and a note say how to get more.

ParameterTypeDescription
querystrrequiredSearch query (case-insensitive, multi-word AND).
limitintoptionalMost hits to return (at most 50; fewer when they would not fit).
offsetintoptionalSkip this many of the best hits: the 'next_offset' of the last call.

list_chapters — List chapters and their sections by ID and title, subsections included (a nested one carries parent_id). Without 'chapter': every chapter, with its sections when the whole listing fits one result (otherwise titles and section counts, and a note). With 'chapter': that chapter's sections.

ParameterTypeDescription
chapterintoptionalChapter number: list its sections. Leave out for every chapter.

load_chapter — Load a whole chapter: every section's text. A chapter too long for one result (most are) comes back as its list of sections with a note: fetch the ones you need with retrieve_section.

ParameterTypeDescription
chapterintrequiredChapter number.

10.1.38 eurocode_7_2 — eurocode_7_2

table_2_1_test_applicability — Applicability of field investigation methods to a soil property (Table 2.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
soil_propertystrrequiredProperty key: 'type_of_soil', 'type_of_rock', 'extension_of_layers', 'groundwater_level', 'pore_water_pressure', 'particle_size', 'water_content', 'atterberg_limits', 'density', 'shear_strength', 'compressibility', 'permeability', 'chemical_tests'.
methodstroptionalInvestigation method key (optional). If given, returns the rating for that single method. Valid keys: 'sampling_soil_a/b/c', 'sampling_rock_a/b/c', 'cpt_cptu', 'pressuremeter', 'rdt', 'flexible_dilatometer', 'spt', 'dpl_dpm', 'dph_dpsh', 'wst', 'fvt', 'dmt', 'plt', 'groundwater_open', 'groundwater_closed'. If empty, returns ratings for all methods.

table_3_1_quality_class — Soil sample quality class properties and sampling category (Table 3.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
quality_classintrequiredQuality class 1 (least disturbed) to 5 (most disturbed).

table_d1_phi_e_from_qc — Effective angle of shearing resistance and drained modulus from CPT (Table D.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
qc_mpafloatrequiredMean cone penetration resistance in the layer, in MPa. Must be >= 0.
soil_typestroptional'sand' (values as tabulated), 'silty' (phi' reduced by 3 degrees per note a), or 'gravelly' (phi' increased by 2 degrees per note a).

table_d2_alpha_oedometer — Correlation factor alpha for Eoed = alpha * qc, by soil type (Table D.2).

ParameterTypeDescription
soil_typestrrequired'low_plasticity_clay', 'low_plasticity_silt', 'very_plastic_clay', 'very_plastic_silt', 'very_organic_silt', 'chalk', or 'sand'.
qc_mpafloatrequiredCone penetration resistance, in MPa.

table_d3_pile_base_resistance — Unit base resistance of cast in-situ piles in coarse soil (Table D.3).

ParameterTypeDescription
settlement_ratiofloatrequiredNormalised settlement s/Db. Tabulated at 0.02, 0.03, and 0.10 (0.10 corresponds to ultimate settlement sg).
qc_mpafloatrequiredAverage cone penetration resistance, in MPa (tabulated 10-25 MPa; clamped at endpoints).
enlarged_basebooloptionalIf True, multiply the result by 0.75 per the table note (piles with pile-base enlargement).

table_d4_pile_shaft_resistance — Unit shaft resistance of cast in-situ piles in coarse soil (Table D.4).

ParameterTypeDescription
qc_mpafloatrequiredAverage cone penetration resistance, in MPa.

table_d5_alpha_p_alpha_s_sand — Maximum alpha_p, alpha_s for sands and gravelly sands (Table D.5).

ParameterTypeDescription
pile_typestrrequired'driven_prefab', 'driven_cast_in_place_closed_tube', 'flight_auger', or 'bored_with_mud'.

table_d6_alpha_s_clay_silt_peat — Maximum alpha_s for clay, silt and peat (Table D.6, Dutch CPT pile method).

ParameterTypeDescription
soil_typestrrequired'clay', 'silt', or 'peat'.
qc_mpafloatoptionalCone resistance (MPa). Only clay is qc-banded (> 3 MPa -> 0.030, < 3 MPa -> 0.020); when omitted for clay, BOTH band values are returned and alpha_s_max conservatively reports the lower band.

table_e1_pmt_bearing_factor_k — Bearing resistance factor k for spread foundations from PMT (Table E.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
soil_categorystrrequired'clay_and_silt', 'sand_and_gravel', 'chalk', or 'marl_and_weathered_rock'.
plm_categorystrrequired'a', 'b', or 'c' (increasing Menard limit pressure PLM category; 'chalk' and 'marl_and_weathered_rock' only have category 'a').
b_mfloatrequiredFoundation width B, in m.
l_mfloatrequiredFoundation length L, in m (L >= B).
de_mfloatrequiredEquivalent depth of foundation De, in m.

table_e2_pmt_shape_coefficients — Shape coefficients for settlement of spread foundations from PMT (Table E.2).

ParameterTypeDescription
lb_ratiofloatrequiredFoundation length-to-width ratio L/B (1 = circle/square).
shapestroptional'circle' or 'square' (rectangular foundations use the square column per the standard's simplified table). Ignored for lambda_c, which is shape-independent.

table_e3_pmt_rheological_factor — Rheological factor alpha for settlement of spread foundations from PMT (Table E.3).

ParameterTypeDescription
ground_typestrrequiredGround type key, e.g. 'clay_normally_consolidated', 'sand_dense', 'rock_weathered'. See _TABLE_E3 keys for the full list.

table_e4_pmt_pile_compression_factor — Compression resistance factor k for axially loaded piles from PMT (Table E.4).

ParameterTypeDescription
soil_categorystrrequired'clay_and_silt', 'sand_and_gravel', or 'chalk'.
plm_categorystrrequired'a', 'b', or 'c'.
pile_typestroptional'bored' (bored piles and small displacement piles) or 'displacement' (full displacement piles).

table_f1_density_index_from_n160 — Density index from normalised SPT blow count (N1)60 (Table F.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
n1_60floatrequiredNormalised SPT blow count (N1)60. Valid range 0-58.

table_f2_ageing_factor — Effect of ageing on normalised SPT blow count for fine sands (Table F.2).

ParameterTypeDescription
deposit_typestrrequired'laboratory_tests' (age ~10^-2 years), 'recent_fills' (~10 years), or 'natural_deposits' (>10^2 years).

table_f3_phi_from_density_index — Effective angle of shearing resistance of silica sands from ID (Table F.3).

ParameterTypeDescription
density_index_pctfloatrequiredDensity index ID, in percent (0-100; clamped at endpoints 40-100).
grain_sizestrrequired'fine', 'medium', or 'coarse'.
gradingstrrequired'uniform' or 'well_graded'.

table_g1_phi_from_density_index_dp — Effective angle of shearing resistance of coarse soil from DP (Table G.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
gradingstrrequired'poorly_graded' (Cu < 6, e.g. sand/sand-gravel) or 'well_graded' (6 <= Cu <= 15, e.g. sand/sand-gravel/gravel).
density_statestrrequired'loose', 'medium_dense', or 'dense'.

table_h1_phi_e_from_wst — Effective angle of shearing resistance and drained modulus from WST (Table H.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
density_categorystrrequired'very_loose', 'loose', 'medium_dense', 'dense', or 'very_dense'.
soil_typestroptional'sand' (as tabulated), 'silty' (phi' reduced 3 deg per note), or 'gravelly' (phi' increased 2 deg per note).

table_l1_sample_mass — Minimum mass of disturbed soil required for testing (Table L.1, partial).

ParameterTypeDescription
teststrrequired'water_content', 'particle_density', 'consistency_limits', or 'density_index'.

table_l2_min_mass_sieving — Minimum mass for sieving (MMS) by largest particle diameter (Table L.2).

ParameterTypeDescription
largest_particle_mmfloatrequiredLargest particle diameter present in significant proportion (10% or more by dry mass), in mm. Valid range 2-75 mm (the kg sub-table; see note for the finer gram-scale sub-table).

table_m1_classification_test_count — Minimum number of classification tests per soil stratum (Table M.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
teststrrequired'particle_size_distribution', 'consistency_limits', or 'loss_on_ignition'.
comparable_experienceboolrequiredTrue if comparable local experience exists, False otherwise.

table_min_test_count — Recommended minimum number of tests for one stratum/formation.

ParameterTypeDescription
test_familystrrequired'triaxial_phi' (Table P.1, by regression coefficient r), 'triaxial_su' (Table P.1, by max/min undrained strength ratio), 'direct_shear' (Table P.2), 'oedometer' (Table Q.1, by Eoed range), 'permeability' (Table S.1, by kmax/kmin ratio), or 'rock_uniaxial_compression' (Table W.1, by standard deviation of strength as % of mean; also governs Brazil and triaxial rock tests per the standard).
variabilitystrrequired'low', 'medium', or 'high' (see each family's docstring criterion above for the exact numeric boundary).
comparable_experiencestrrequired'none', 'medium', or 'extensive'.

table_v1_swelling_test_specimens — Minimum rock swelling test specimen requirements (Table V.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
test_typestrrequired'swelling_pressure_zero_volume_change', 'swelling_strain_radially_confined_axial_surcharge', or 'swelling_strain_unconfined'.

equation_4_1_cu_from_cpt — Undrained shear strength from CPT cone resistance (Eq. 4.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
qc_kpafloatrequiredCone penetration resistance, in kPa.
sigma_v0_kpafloatrequiredInitial total vertical overburden stress at the depth considered, in kPa.
nkfloatrequiredCone factor, estimated from local experience or reliable correlations. Must be > 0.

equation_4_2_cu_from_cptu — Undrained shear strength from CPTU corrected cone resistance (Eq. 4.2).

ParameterTypeDescription
qt_kpafloatrequiredCone penetration resistance corrected for pore water pressure effects, in kPa.
sigma_v0_kpafloatrequiredInitial total vertical overburden stress at the depth considered, in kPa.
nktfloatrequiredCone factor for CPTU, estimated from local experience or reliable correlations. Must be > 0.

equation_4_3_oedometer_modulus_from_qc — Oedometer modulus from CPT cone resistance (Eq. 4.3).

ParameterTypeDescription
alphafloatrequiredCorrelation factor depending on local experience (see tables.table_d2_alpha_oedometer for example values by soil type, Annex D.4).
qc_mpafloatrequiredCone penetration resistance, in MPa.

equation_4_4_cu_from_fvt — Undrained shear strength from field vane test (Eq. 4.4).

ParameterTypeDescription
mufloatrequiredCorrection factor, determined based on local experience (see equation_i5_fvt_correction_factor for example formulas, Annex I.5).
cfv_kpafloatrequiredUndrained shear strength measured in the field vane test, in kPa.

equation_4_5_cu_from_dmt — Undrained shear strength of non-cemented clays from DMT (Eq. 4.5).

ParameterTypeDescription
sigma_v0_eff_kpafloatrequiredInitial effective vertical stress at the test depth, in kPa.
k_dmtfloatrequiredHorizontal stress index from the flat dilatometer test.
i_dmtfloatoptionalMaterial index from the flat dilatometer test. If given and >= 0.8, raises ValueError (outside the equation's stated validity).

equation_burland_burbridge_icc — Foundation subgrade compressibility index Icc from average SPT N (F.3(3)).

ParameterTypeDescription
n_avgfloatrequiredArithmetic mean of measured (uncorrected) SPT N-values over the depth of influence z1 = B^0.75. Must be > 0.

equation_burland_burbridge_settlement — Immediate settlement of a square footing on sand (Burland & Burbridge, F.3).

ParameterTypeDescription
b_mfloatrequiredFooting width B, in m. Must be > 0.
iccfloatrequiredFoundation subgrade compressibility index (see equation_burland_burbridge_icc).
q_kpafloatrequiredAverage effective foundation pressure q', in kPa.
sigma_p_kpafloatrequiredMaximum previous overburden pressure sigma'p, in kPa.

equation_burland_burbridge_shape_factor — Length-to-width correction factor fs for Burland & Burbridge settlement (F.3(6)).

ParameterTypeDescription
l_over_bfloatrequiredFoundation length-to-width ratio L/B. Must be >= 1.

equation_d2_phi_from_qc — Effective angle of shearing resistance from CPT, poorly-graded sands (D.2).

ParameterTypeDescription
qc_mpafloatrequiredCone penetration resistance, in MPa. Must be in [5, 28].

equation_d3_settlement_coefficients — C1, C2, C3 coefficients for the Schmertmann settlement method (D.3).

ParameterTypeDescription
sigma_v0_eff_kpafloatrequiredInitial effective vertical stress at the foundation level, in kPa.
q_kpafloatrequiredDesign normal pressure applied on the foundation, in kPa. Must be > sigma_v0_eff_kpa.
t_yearsfloatrequiredTime since load application, in years. Must be > 0.
foundation_shapestrrequired'square' (C3 = 1.25) or 'strip' (C3 = 1.75, valid for L > 10B).
l_over_bfloatoptionalFoundation length-to-width ratio (informational; strip requires L > 10B per the standard).

equation_d3_youngs_modulus_from_qc — Drained Young's modulus from CPT for Schmertmann settlement method (D.3).

ParameterTypeDescription
qc_mpafloatrequiredCone penetration resistance, in MPa.
foundation_shapestrrequired'axisymmetric' (circular/square) or 'plane_strain' (strip).

equation_d5_stiffness_coefficient_from_qc — Stiffness coefficient w1 from CPT cone resistance (Annex D.5).

ParameterTypeDescription
soil_typestrrequired'poorly_graded_sand', 'well_graded_sand', or 'low_plasticity_clay'.
qc_mpafloatrequiredCone penetration resistance, in MPa (validity range depends on soil_type; see above).

equation_g1_density_index_from_dp — Density index from dynamic probing (DP) blow count N10 (Annex G.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
n10floatrequiredNumber of blows per 10 cm penetration (N10L for DPL, N10H for DPH).
gradingstrrequired'poorly_graded' (Cu <= 3) or 'well_graded' (Cu >= 6, sand-gravel).
groundwaterstrrequired'above' or 'below' groundwater level.
probe_typestrrequired'dpl' (dynamic probing light) or 'dph' (dynamic probing heavy).

equation_g3_stiffness_coefficient_from_dp — Stiffness coefficient w1 from dynamic probing (DP) blow count (Annex G.3).

ParameterTypeDescription
n10floatrequiredNumber of blows per 10 cm penetration.
soil_typestrrequired'sand' (poorly-graded, Cu<=3) or 'clay' (low-plasticity, stiff).
probe_typestrrequired'dpl' or 'dph'.

equation_i5_fvt_correction_factor — Field vane correction factor mu from Atterberg limits and OCR (Annex I.5).

ParameterTypeDescription
w_l_pctfloatrequiredLiquid limit wL, in percent (e.g. 60 for 60%). Must be > 0.
rocfloatoptionalOver-consolidation ratio, if known. If given and > 1.3, uses the Roc-based formula.
cfv_kpafloatoptionalUndrained shear strength measured in the field vane test, in kPa (used with sigma_v0_eff_kpa when roc is not known, to estimate the OCR-adjusted correction).
sigma_v0_eff_kpafloatoptionalInitial effective vertical stress, in kPa (paired with cfv_kpa).

equation_j_dmt_oedometer_modulus — One-dimensional tangent modulus Eoed from DMT results (Annex J).

ParameterTypeDescription
i_dmtfloatrequiredMaterial index from the flat dilatometer test.
k_dmtfloatrequiredHorizontal stress index from the flat dilatometer test. Must be > 0.
e_dmt_mpafloatrequiredDilatometer modulus EDMT, in MPa.

equation_k1_plt_undrained_shear_strength — Undrained shear strength from a plate loading test (Annex K.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
pu_kpafloatrequiredUltimate contact pressure from the PLT results, in kPa.
gamma_z_kpafloatrequiredTotal stress (unit weight times depth) at the test level, in kPa (only relevant/nonzero for boreholes with diameter smaller than 3 times the plate diameter).
plate_conditionstroptional'surface' (Nc=6) or 'borehole_deep' (Nc=9, depth > 4x plate diameter/width).

equation_k2_plt_modulus — Plate settlement modulus EpLT from a plate loading test (Annex K.2).

ParameterTypeDescription
delta_p_kpafloatrequiredSelected range of applied contact pressure considered, in kPa.
delta_s_mmfloatrequiredChange in total settlement (including creep) for delta_p_kpa, in mm. Must be > 0.
b_mfloatrequiredDiameter of the plate, in m.
poissonfloatoptionalPoisson's ratio: 0.5 for undrained conditions in fine soil (default), 0.3 for coarse soil, if not otherwise determined.
czfloatoptionalDepth correction factor for borehole-base tests (Figure K.1); use 1.0 (default) for surface/excavation tests.

equation_k3_plt_subgrade_reaction — Coefficient of sub-grade reaction ks from a plate loading test (Annex K.3).

ParameterTypeDescription
delta_p_kpafloatrequiredSelected range of applied contact pressure considered, in kPa.
delta_s_mmfloatrequiredChange in settlement (including creep) for delta_p_kpa, in mm. Must be > 0.

equation_n_caco3_from_co2 — Equivalent calcium carbonate content from CO2 content (Annex N.3.2).

ParameterTypeDescription
co2_pctfloatrequiredCO2 content, as a percentage of dry weight. Must be >= 0.

equation_n_so4_from_so3 — Sulfate (SO4) content from sulfur trioxide (SO3) content (Annex N.4.1).

ParameterTypeDescription
so3_pctfloatrequiredSO3 content, as a percentage. Must be >= 0.
