nonpermanent_structure_wind_reduction_factor — Paragraph 1609.3.3: basic-wind-speed reduction factor permitted for non-permanent structures (design life <= 5 years) per UFC 1-201-01, applicable both inside and outside hurricane-prone regions per this UFC's Change (printed pp. 20-21). Supersedes UFC 1-201-01 paragraph 3-2.1.5 and IBC Section 3103.6.1.2.

No parameters.

table_2_1_wind_deflection_limit — Table 2-1: wind-induced deflection limit for framing supporting a given exterior wall finish (printed p. 10, IBC Section 1604.3.1 replacement).

ParameterTypeDescription
cladding_typefloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_2_1_DEFLECTION_LIMITS` (e.g. 'brick_veneer').

table_2_2_note — A lettered footnote to Table 2-2 (printed pp. 12-14).

ParameterTypeDescription
note_idfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_2_2_NOTES` ('a' through 'h').

table_2_2_risk_category — Table 2-2: risk category assignment data, REPLACING IBC Table 1604.5 and ASCE 7-22 Tables 1.5-1/1.5-2 (printed pp. 11-14; paragraph 3-1.2).

ParameterTypeDescription
risk_categoryfloatrequired'I', 'II', 'III', 'IV', or 'V'.

table_e1_live_load — Table E-1: minimum uniformly distributed live load and minimum concentrated live load for an occupancy or use classification (Appendix E, printed pp. 153-159). REPLACES IBC Table 1607.1; occupancies with `military_added=True` are DoD-specific additions to the base IBC table (shown bold-italic in the source).

ParameterTypeDescription
occupancyfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_E1_LIVE_LOADS` (e.g. 'office_offices', 'hospitals_patient_rooms').

table_e1_note — A lettered footnote to Table E-1 (printed pp. 158-159).

ParameterTypeDescription
note_idfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_E1_NOTES` ('a' through 'j').

vertical_ground_motion_threshold_check — Paragraph 1605.1.2: determines whether the design short-period spectral response acceleration, SDS, triggers the additional load combinations of paragraph 2.3.6/2.4.5 for vertical-ground-motion- sensitive members (printed pp. 14-15). Threshold: SDS > 0.6g (derived from a 2004 Eurocode 8 peak-vertical-ground-acceleration criterion, avg > 0.25g, per the [C] commentary).

ParameterTypeDescription
sdsfloatrequiredDesign spectral response acceleration at short periods, in units of g (e.g. 0.65 for 0.65g).

wind_speed_conversion_asd — Eq 16-18a: converts basic (strength-level) wind speed to an allowable-stress-design wind speed (printed p. 19).

ParameterTypeDescription
vfloatrequiredBasic wind speed, V (mph or consistent unit).

wind_speed_conversion_fastest_mile — Eq 16-18b: converts basic wind speed to a fastest-mile wind speed (printed p. 19).

ParameterTypeDescription
vfloatrequiredBasic wind speed, V (mph).

list_table_3_1_systems — Lists Table 3-1 system keys.

ParameterTypeDescription
categoryfloatoptionalIf given, list only systems in that category ('A'-'H'). If omitted, return {category: [systems...]} for all categories.

list_table_7_1_systems — Lists Table 7-1 (healthcare) system keys; see `list_table_3_1_systems` for the parameter/return convention.

ParameterTypeDescription
categoryfloatoptional

list_table_b1_systems — Lists Table B-1 (RC IV alternate design) system keys; see `list_table_3_1_systems` for the parameter/return convention (category names here are the full Table B-1 section headers).

ParameterTypeDescription
categoryfloatoptional

table_3_1_footnote — A lettered footnote to Table 3-1 (printed p. 57).

ParameterTypeDescription
footnote_idfloatrequired

table_3_1_seismic_system — Table 3-1: seismic force-resisting system design coefficients (R, Omega0, Cd) and structural-height limits by Seismic Design Category, REPLACING ASCE 7-22 Table 12.2-1 in its entirety (printed pp. 49-57).

ParameterTypeDescription
categoryfloatrequired'A' through 'H' (a key of `TABLE_3_1`).
systemfloatrequiredA system key within that category (see `list_table_3_1_systems`).

table_7_1_healthcare_seismic_system — Table 7-1: permitted seismic force-resisting systems and design coefficients for Chapter 6/7 critical healthcare facilities, REPLACING ASCE 7-16 Table 12.2-1 for those facilities (printed pp. 98-99). Only systems listed in this table are permitted within the Chapter 7 scope (paragraph 12.2.1 [Supplement]).

ParameterTypeDescription
categoryfloatrequired'B', 'C', or 'D' (the only categories with permitted healthcare systems).
systemfloatrequiredA system key within that category (see `list_table_7_1_systems`).

table_b1_footnote — A numbered footnote to Table B-1 (printed p. 126).

ParameterTypeDescription
footnote_idfloatrequired

table_b1_rc4_permitted_system — Table B-1: permitted seismic force-resisting systems and height limits for Risk Category IV buildings using the Appendix B alternate nonlinear-design procedure (printed pp. 124-126). This table REPLACES both ASCE 7-22 Table 12.2-1 and this UFC's own Table 3-1 when the Appendix B procedure is used; R, Cd, and Omega0 do not apply (paragraph B-18.4.2.4).

ParameterTypeDescription
categoryfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_B_1` (e.g. 'Building Frame Systems'). Matched case-insensitively.
systemfloatrequiredA system key within that category (see `list_table_b1_systems`).

alternate_rc4_seismic_combination — Eq B-1/B-2: Appendix B alternate nonlinear-design seismic load combinations for Risk Category IV buildings, REPLACING ASCE 7-22 Section 2.3.6 combinations 6/7 when the Appendix B alternate procedure is used (printed p. 112).

ParameterTypeDescription
dfloatrequiredDead load effect, D.
lfloatrequiredUnreduced design live load effect, L.
sfloatrequiredDesign flat-roof snow load effect, S (per ASCE 7-22 for an RC IV building; may be taken as 0 if < 40 psf per the exception).
efloatrequiredHorizontal-and-vertical earthquake effect, E, at the BSE-1N or MCER target displacement (from nonlinear analysis).
combinationfloatoptional'additive' (Eq B-1, default) or 'counteractive' (Eq B-2).

basic_combination_with_vertical_seismic_asd — Paragraph 2.4.5 [Supplement]: additional ASD seismic load combinations 11, 12, and 13, required (in addition to ASCE 7-22's standard combinations 8/9/10) for the vertical-ground-motion-sensitive members of paragraph 1605.1.2 (printed pp. 45-46).

ParameterTypeDescription
dfloatrequired
ev0floatrequired
ehfloatrequired
lfloatoptional
sfloatoptional
overstrengthfloatoptional

basic_combination_with_vertical_seismic_lrfd — Paragraph 2.3.6 [Supplement]: additional LRFD seismic load combinations 8 and 9, required (in addition to ASCE 7-22's standard combinations 6/7) for the vertical-ground-motion-sensitive members of paragraph 1605.1.2 (printed p. 44).

ParameterTypeDescription
dfloatrequiredDead load effect, D.
ev0floatrequiredVertical seismic effect (`vertical_seismic_effect_ev0`, or from the ASCE 7-22 Section 11.9 vertical response spectrum).
ehfloatrequiredHorizontal seismic load effect, Eh (or Emh if overstrength=True).
lfloatoptionalLive load effect, L. Default 0.
sfloatoptionalSnow load effect, S. Default 0.
overstrengthfloatoptionalIf True, eh is interpreted as Emh (overstrength horizontal seismic effect) per ASCE 7-22 Section 12.4.3. Default False.

coupling_beam_shear_demand — Paragraph 2106.2.3 [Addition]: for coupling beams between shear walls in structures assigned to SDC D or higher, the required design shear strength must satisfy (printed pp. 36-37):

ParameterTypeDescription
mn1floatrequired
mn2floatrequired
lcfloatrequiredLength of the beam between the shear walls.
vgfloatrequiredUnfactored shear force on the beam due to gravity loads.

structural_separation_healthcare — Eq 12.12-1 [Replacement]: structural separation (maximum inelastic displacement) for critical healthcare facilities, replacing the ASCE 7-16 Equation 12.12-1 form used in Chapter 7 (printed p. 100).

ParameterTypeDescription
cdfloatrequiredDeflection amplification factor, Cd (Table 7-1).
delta_maxfloatrequiredMaximum elastic displacement at the critical location, delta_max.

vertical_seismic_effect_ev0 — Ev0 = 0.67*SDS*D, one of two permitted ways to determine the vertical ground motion effect used in the additional seismic load combinations of paragraph 2.3.6/2.4.5 (printed pp. 44, 46). The alternative is to take Ev0 directly from the ASCE 7-22 Section 11.9 design vertical response spectrum (not implemented here -- site/period dependent).

ParameterTypeDescription
sdsfloatrequiredDesign spectral response acceleration at short periods (g).
dfloatrequiredDead load effect, D.

evaluation_trigger_cost_threshold — RP 10 Section 1.2.1 Items c/d [Replacement]: project-cost threshold (as a fraction of pre-construction replacement cost, excluding tenant operational equipment/fit-outs/seismic mitigation) that triggers a mandatory seismic evaluation for an addition/alteration/repair project (printed p. 69).

ParameterTypeDescription
seismic_design_categoryfloatrequired'C' (50% threshold) or 'D', 'E', or 'F' (30% threshold).

performance_level_definition — Definition of a Table 4-1(a)/(b) performance-level abbreviation (Table 4-1(a) note 1, printed p. 73; Table 4-1(b) note 1, printed p. 75).

ParameterTypeDescription
abbreviationfloatrequiredA key of `PERFORMANCE_LEVEL_ABBREVIATIONS` (case-insensitive except for the 'm'/'M' distinguishing LmS from LS -- pass exactly as printed, e.g. 'LmS', 'CP', 'HR').

roof_diaphragm_high_wind_retrofit_trigger — IEBC Section 503.12 [Replacement]: determines whether an alteration/ repair triggers a mandatory roof-diaphragm wind-load evaluation in a high-wind region (printed pp. 83-84). High-wind region: basic wind speed for RC II structures > 130 mph, or a special wind region per this UFC.

ParameterTypeDescription
basic_wind_speed_mphfloatrequiredBasic wind speed for a Risk Category II structure at the site (mph).
cost_fractionfloatoptionalAlteration/repair cost as a fraction of replacement value (0-1).
reroofing_fractionfloatoptionalFraction of roofing material removed during re-roofing (0-1), for RC III/IV buildings.

rp10_incidental_occupancy_exemption — RP 10 Section 1.3 Item e [Replacement]: the incidental-human- occupancy exemption threshold for Risk Category I/II building structures (printed p. 76).

No parameters.

table_4_1a_structural_performance_objective — Table 4-1(a): structural performance objective for a given RP 10 evaluation/retrofit trigger, REPLACING RP 10 Tables 2-1/2-2/2-3 (printed pp. 72-73). See the module docstring caveat on the literal-cell-text representation of the Risk Category I/II and III columns.

ParameterTypeDescription
triggerfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_4_1A` (e.g. 'a', 'b_addition', 'i', 'screening').

table_4_1b_nonstructural_performance_objective — Table 4-1(b): nonstructural performance objective for a given RP 10 trigger and risk category, REPLACING RP 10 Tables 2-1/2-2/2-3 (printed pp. 74-75). The same two-tier objective applies to both evaluation and retrofit.

ParameterTypeDescription
triggerfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_4_1B` (e.g. 'a', 'b_addition', 'i', 'screening').
risk_categoryfloatrequired'I_II', 'III', or 'IV' (case-insensitive; 'I' and 'II' are grouped as in the printed table).

healthcare_elevator_seismic_force_asd — Paragraph 13.6.11.1.1 [Addition]: minimum ASD-level seismic force for elevator guide rail support-bracket fastenings and supporting structural framing at critical healthcare facilities, and the load distribution to top/bottom guiding members (printed pp. 100-101).

No parameters.

healthcare_retaining_wall_lateral_load_minimum — Paragraph 1807.2.2 [Replacement]: minimum design lateral soil load for retaining walls at critical healthcare facilities, and the SDC D/E/F seismic increment trigger (printed p. 88).

No parameters.

healthcare_structural_configuration_limits — Paragraph 12.1.7 [Addition]: structural configuration limitations for critical healthcare facilities (printed pp. 95-96): uniform bay spacing, a restriction on transfer beams/trusses, seismic-joint sizing at 125% of the ASCE 7-16 requirement, and adjacent-structure separation.

No parameters.

table_6_1_masonry_wall_thickness — Table 6-1: minimum masonry wall thickness and maximum unsupported height/length-to-thickness ratio, for TMS 402-16 Section 8.3.4.4 (paragraph 6-5.3, printed p. 93). For varying-thickness walls, use the least thickness (note 1); for a cantilevered wall use twice its unsupported dimension (note 2); freestanding cantilevered walls carrying no applied vertical load are exempt (note 3), subject to stress/overturning requirements.

ParameterTypeDescription
wall_typefloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_6_1_MASONRY_WALL_THICKNESS` (e.g. 'reinforced_hollow_unit_masonry_bearing_or_shear').

list_nonbuilding_structure_types — Lists the nonbuilding structure type keys covered by Chapter 5.

No parameters.

nonbuilding_structure_governing_standard — Chapter 5: the governing design standard for a nonbuilding structure type not otherwise covered by this UFC's Chapters 2/3 (printed pp. 85-86).

ParameterTypeDescription
structure_typefloatrequiredA key of `NONBUILDING_STRUCTURE_STANDARDS` (e.g. 'highway_bridge', 'tanks_petroleum_storage').

certification_out_of_plane_response_threshold — Appendix D [guidance]: the out-of-plane-to-in-plane response ratio threshold used to decide whether ICC-ES AC156 shake-table qualification testing must be triaxial (significant cross-coupling) or may be biaxial (printed p. 150).

No parameters.

counterweight_tie_bracket_spacing — Section C-3.3 [guidance]: for SDC D/E/F, maximum counterweight rail tie-bracket spacing tied to the building structure, and the intermediate-spreader-bracket thresholds (printed p. 145).

No parameters.

elevator_equipment_car_rpo_ratio — Section C-3.3 [guidance]: CAR/Rpo for elevator machinery and equipment (printed p. 145).

ParameterTypeDescription
is_rigid_and_rigidly_attachedfloatrequiredTrue for rigid/rigidly-attached equipment (CAR/Rpo = 1.0); False for non-rigid/flexibly-mounted equipment with period > 0.06 s (CAR/Rpo = 2.5).

elevator_guide_rail_deflection_limits — Section C-3.3 [guidance]: maximum horizontal deflection of elevator guide rails (between supports) and of their support brackets (printed p. 144).

No parameters.

elevator_retainer_plate_clearance — Section C-3.3 [guidance]: for SDC D/E/F, maximum clearance between the machined faces of elevator guide rail and retainer plates (printed p. 145).

No parameters.

flexible_pipe_clearance_requirements — Section C-3.1.3.2.2 [guidance]: minimum clearance requirements for flexible piping systems (printed pp. 137-138).

No parameters.

nonrigid_partition_drift_capacity — Section C-2.2 [guidance]: assumed in-plane story-drift capacity of a standard-practice nonrigid partition wall (stud-and-drywall, stud-and-plaster, movable partitions) before damage occurs (printed p. 132). Much less than the most restrictive ASCE 7-22 Table 12.12-1 story-drift limit -- damage should be expected unless the partition is isolated from in-plane building motion.

No parameters.

pipe_car_rpo_ratio — Section C-3.1.3.2.1/2.2: the component-resonance-ductility-factor to component-strength-factor ratio, CAR/Rpo, used in ASCE 7-22 Eq 13.3-1 for pipe seismic force calculation (printed pp. 137, 138).

ParameterTypeDescription
is_rigidfloatrequiredTrue if the piping system's fundamental period <= 0.06 s (rigid, CAR/Rpo = 1.0); False if flexible (period > 0.06 s, CAR/Rpo = 2.5).

rigid_pipe_fundamental_period — Eq C-1: fundamental period of a pipe span (printed p. 137).

ParameterTypeDescription
support_conditionfloatrequired'pinned_pinned', 'fixed_pinned', or 'fixed_fixed'.
lengthfloatrequiredPipe span, L (in. or mm, consistent with ei/w).
eifloatrequiredFlexural rigidity, E*I (consistent units).
wfloatrequiredWeight of pipe and contents per unit length (lb/in. or N/mm).

rigid_pipe_period_constant — Eq C-1 period constant, C, by pipe support condition (printed p. 137, excerpted from the Shock and Vibration Handbook, 6th Ed., 2009).

ParameterTypeDescription
support_conditionfloatrequired'pinned_pinned', 'fixed_pinned', or 'fixed_fixed'.

table_c1_pipe_span — Table C-1: maximum span for rigid pipe with pinned-pinned support conditions (Figure C-6), based on water-filled pipes at Ta = 0.06 s (printed p. 138).

ParameterTypeDescription
diameter_infloatrequiredNominal pipe/tube diameter in inches (a key of `TABLE_C1_PINNED_PINNED`, e.g. 1, 1.5, 2, ..., 12).
pipe_typefloatrequiredOne of 'std_wt_steel_40s', 'ex_strong_steel_80s', 'copper_tube_type_k', 'copper_tube_type_l', 'copper_tube_type_m', 'red_brass_sps_copper'.

table_c2_pipe_span — Table C-2: maximum span for rigid pipe with fixed-pinned support conditions (Figure C-7) (printed p. 139). See `table_c1_pipe_span` for parameter/return convention.

ParameterTypeDescription
diameter_infloatrequired
pipe_typefloatrequired

table_c3_pipe_span — Table C-3: maximum span for rigid pipe with fixed-fixed support conditions (Figure C-8) (printed p. 140). See `table_c1_pipe_span` for parameter/return convention.

ParameterTypeDescription
diameter_infloatrequired
pipe_typefloatrequired

gfrp_bend_strength_reduction_factor — Paragraph G-3.2: minimum guaranteed ultimate tensile force of a bent portion of a GFRP bar, as a fraction of the straight-portion ultimate tensile force (ASTM D7957/D7957M) (printed p. 184). ACI CODE 440.11-22 limits shear reinforcement stress to be compatible with this limit.

No parameters.

gfrp_environmental_reduction_factor — Paragraph G-5.1: environmental reduction factor, CE, applied to the guaranteed ultimate tensile strength of GFRP reinforcement to account for uncertainty in long-term durability predictive models (ACI CODE 440.11-22 Chapter 20) (printed p. 187).

No parameters.

gfrp_fire_rating_limitation — Paragraph G-1.3: DoD does not allow GFRP reinforcement in structures with a fire rating above zero, or in similar structures without a fire rating that could collapse due to fire and threaten life safety (printed pp. 181-182). Also prohibited in architectural cast-in-place concrete; permitted in architectural precast concrete only if all connections use steel.

No parameters.

gfrp_seismic_applicability — Paragraph G-1.3 / G-4.4: whether GFRP reinforcement is permitted for a given Seismic Design Category and structural role (printed pp. 181-182, 208).

ParameterTypeDescription
seismic_design_categoryfloatrequired'A' through 'F'.
is_part_of_lateral_force_resisting_systemfloatrequiredTrue if the member is part of the seismic force-resisting system.

gfrp_sustained_stress_limit — Paragraph G-4.2: maximum sustained-stress limit on GFRP reinforcement, as a fraction of ultimate tensile stress, to address creep rupture and static fatigue (ACI CODE 440.11-22 Chapter 24) (printed pp. 185-186).

No parameters.

gfrp_temperature_limits — Paragraph G-5.3: minimum required glass transition temperature (ASTM D7957/D7957M) and the ACI CODE 440.11-22 suggested in-service temperature limit, 27 deg F below the glass transition temperature (printed pp. 187-188).

No parameters.

gfrp_uv_exposure_storage_limit — Paragraph G-5.3 / G-6: maximum outdoor storage duration before GFRP bars must be covered with opaque plastic, per the UFC's construction- specification limit (UFGS 03 30 00), which is more conservative than ACI 440.5's recommendation (printed pp. 188, 189).

No parameters.

table_g1_material_property — Table G-1: GFRP (ASTM D7957/D7957M) vs. steel (ASTM A615/A615M) reinforcing bar material-property comparison (printed p. 185).

ParameterTypeDescription
property_namefloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_G_1` (e.g. 'modulus_of_elasticity', 'ultimate_tensile_strength').

best_practice_guidance — Appendix A: topic-indexed best-practice guidance (printed pp. 103-108).

ParameterTypeDescription
topicfloatrequiredA key of `BEST_PRACTICE_TOPICS` (e.g. 'building_drift_limits', 'gable_bent_footings').

gable_bent_tie_rod_force_range — Paragraph A-2.1: the horizontal thrust force range above which tie rods (rather than hairpin bars) are usually the cost-effective choice for resisting metal-building gable-bent column-base reactions (printed p. 105).

No parameters.

list_best_practice_topics — Lists the Appendix A best-practice topic keys.

No parameters.

masonry_veneer_ledge_offset — Paragraph A-4.1: masonry veneer foundation ledge criteria (printed p. 106) -- the ledge must be at least 4 in. lower than the stud-wall base, and at least (2/3 * veneer thickness + minimum air space) wide.

No parameters.

shelf_angle_deflection_limit — Paragraph A-5.1: maximum deflection of the horizontal leg of a masonry shelf angle under masonry loading, at the end of the leg (including support rotation) (printed p. 106).

No parameters.

retrieve_section — Retrieve one section by its ID, at any level: its own text, 'under' (the sections above it) and 'children' (ID and title of each subsection, fetched by its own ID). A missing ID's error names the nearest section above it and the sections numbered under it.

ParameterTypeDescription
section_idstrrequiredSection identifier at any level (e.g. '1-1', '1-8.1').
include_subsectionsbooloptionalInline the subsections' text too, when the whole fits in 12,000 characters; otherwise they stay listed in 'children' with a note.

search_sections — Keyword search across every section and subsection, best first: each hit is a section's number, title, chapter, 'under' (the sections above it) and a snippet of its text, never the whole text (retrieve_section fetches that). As many hits as fit; 'next_offset' and a note say how to get more.

ParameterTypeDescription
querystrrequiredSearch query (case-insensitive, multi-word AND).
limitintoptionalMost hits to return (at most 50; fewer when they would not fit).
offsetintoptionalSkip this many of the best hits: the 'next_offset' of the last call.

list_chapters — List chapters and their sections by ID and title, subsections included (a nested one carries parent_id). Without 'chapter': every chapter, with its sections when the whole listing fits one result (otherwise titles and section counts, and a note). With 'chapter': that chapter's sections.

ParameterTypeDescription
chapterintoptionalChapter number: list its sections. Leave out for every chapter.

load_chapter — Load a whole chapter: every section's text. A chapter too long for one result (most are) comes back as its list of sections with a note: fetch the ones you need with retrieve_section.

ParameterTypeDescription
chapterintrequiredChapter number.

10.1.48 wood_handbook — wood_handbook

convert_specific_gravity — Eq 4-10: convert specific gravity from one moisture-content volume basis x' to another x'' using the volumetric shrinkage at each basis (printed p. 4-11).

ParameterTypeDescription
gx_primefloatrequiredSpecific gravity referenced to volume at moisture content x'.
sx_prime_pctfloatrequiredPercent volumetric shrinkage from green to x' (Eq 4-9).
sx_double_prime_pctfloatrequiredPercent volumetric shrinkage from green to x'' (Eq 4-9).

density_from_ovendry_density — Eq 4-15 (Method 2): density (including water) at moisture content x, from ovendry density rho_0 (printed p. 4-13).

ParameterTypeDescription
rho_0floatrequiredOvendry density (ovendry mass / ovendry volume, kg/m^3).
moisture_content_pctfloatrequiredx (%), <= mc_fs.
s0_pctfloatrequiredS0, percent volumetric shrinkage green-to-ovendry (Table 4-3, or `estimate_total_shrinkage_from_ovendry_density`).
mc_fsfloatoptionalFiber saturation point (%, default 30).

density_from_specific_gravity — Eq 4-14 (Method 1): density (including water) at moisture content x, from specific gravity Gx referenced to volume at that same MC (printed p. 4-12).

ParameterTypeDescription
gxfloatrequiredSpecific gravity referenced to volume at moisture content x (e.g. from `specific_gravity_from_basic`).
moisture_content_pctfloatrequiredx (%).
rho_waterfloatoptionalDensity of water (kg/m^3, default 1000).

equilibrium_moisture_content — Eq 4-5: equilibrium moisture content (%) from the Hailwood-Horrobin sorption model (Simpson 1973), which Table 4-2 was calculated from (printed p. 4-3).

ParameterTypeDescription
temp_cfloatrequiredTemperature (degrees C).
relative_humidityfloatrequiredRelative humidity as a decimal, 0 <= h < 1.

equilibrium_moisture_content_glass — Eq 4-6: alternative EMC equation of Glass and others (2014) (printed p. 4-4). Uses kelvins internally.

ParameterTypeDescription
temp_cfloatrequiredTemperature (degrees C).
relative_humidityfloatrequiredRelative humidity as a decimal, 0 <= h < 1.

estimate_total_shrinkage_from_basic_sg — Eq 4-12: estimate total volumetric shrinkage S0 (green to ovendry, %) from basic specific gravity when S0 is not known for the species (Stamm 1964) (printed p. 4-12).

ParameterTypeDescription
basic_specific_gravityfloatrequiredGb, ovendry mass / green volume.

estimate_total_shrinkage_from_ovendry_density — Eq 4-16: estimate total volumetric shrinkage S0 (%) from ovendry density, the ovendry-density form of Equation (4-12) (printed p. 4-13).

ParameterTypeDescription
rho_0floatrequiredOvendry density (kg/m^3).
rho_waterfloatoptionalDensity of water (kg/m^3, default 1000).

max_moisture_content — Eq 4-3: maximum possible moisture content MCmax (%), reached when both cell lumina and cell walls are completely saturated with water (printed p. 4-3).

ParameterTypeDescription
basic_specific_gravityfloatrequiredGb, ovendry mass / green volume.

relative_humidity_from_emc — Eq 4-7: relative humidity from EMC, the inverted form of Equation (4-6) (Glass and others 2014) (printed p. 4-4).

ParameterTypeDescription
temp_cfloatrequiredTemperature (degrees C).
emc_pctfloatrequiredEquilibrium moisture content (%).

shrinkage_at_moisture_content — Eq 4-9: percent shrinkage Sx from the green condition to a final moisture content x, assuming shrinkage begins at the fiber saturation point and dimensions decrease linearly with decreasing MC below it (printed p. 4-10).

ParameterTypeDescription
s0_pctfloatrequiredS0, percent shrinkage from green to ovendry (radial, tangential, or volumetric; from Table 4-3/4-4, e.g. `table_4_3_shrinkage`).
moisture_content_pctfloatrequiredx, final moisture content (%); should be <= mc_fs for the linear assumption to apply.
mc_fsfloatoptionalFiber saturation point (%, default 30, the printed approximation when MCfs is not known for the species).

sink_moisture_content — Eq 4-4: moisture content at which wood will just sink in water, MCsink (%) (printed p. 4-3).

ParameterTypeDescription
basic_specific_gravityfloatrequiredGb, ovendry mass / green volume.

specific_gravity_from_basic — Eq 4-11 (with S0 given) or Eq 4-13 (with S0 estimated from Gb via Eq 4-12): specific gravity Gx referenced to volume at moisture content x, below the fiber saturation point, computed from basic specific gravity Gb (printed p. 4-12).

ParameterTypeDescription
basic_specific_gravityfloatrequiredGb, ovendry mass / green volume.
moisture_content_pctfloatrequiredx, moisture content (%) at which Gx is wanted (<= mc_fs).
volumetric_s0_pctfloatoptionalS0, percent volumetric shrinkage from green to ovendry (Table 4-3). If omitted, S0 is estimated from Gb via Eq 4-12 (S0 = 26.5*Gb), giving the closed-form Eq 4-13.
mc_fsfloatoptionalFiber saturation point (%, default 30).

table_4_1_green_moisture_content — Table 4-1: average moisture content of green heartwood/sapwood, by species (printed p. 4-2).

ParameterTypeDescription
speciesfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_4_1_GREEN_MC` (case-insensitive).

table_4_3_shrinkage — Table 4-3: radial/tangential/volumetric shrinkage (%) from green to ovendry moisture content, for the module's documented species subset (printed p. 4-8). Values are S0 in Equation (4-9).

ParameterTypeDescription
speciesfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_4_3_SHRINKAGE` (case-insensitive).

thermal_conductivity — Eq 4-17: approximate thermal conductivity k (W/(m*K)) across the grain, for Gx > 0.3, temperatures around 24 degC, and MC < 25% (printed p. 4-13).

ParameterTypeDescription
gxfloatrequiredSpecific gravity based on ovendry mass and volume at moisture content x.
moisture_content_pctfloatrequiredx (%), < 25.

adjust_property_for_moisture_content — Eq 5-3: adjust a clear-wood mechanical property from 12% MC to any other moisture content M below the fiber saturation point, at about 21 degC (70 degF) (printed p. 5-34).

ParameterTypeDescription
p12floatrequiredThe property value at 12% moisture content (Table 5-3).
pgfloatrequiredThe property value at green moisture content (Table 5-3).
moisture_content_pctfloatrequiredM, the target moisture content (%), below Mp.
mp_pctfloatrequiredMp, the species' intersection moisture content (Table 5-13, or `table_5_13_intersection_mc`).

table_5_13_intersection_mc — Table 5-13: intersection moisture content Mp (%) for a species, the point at which mechanical properties begin to change as wood dries from the green condition (printed p. 5-34). Falls back to the documented default Mp = 25 for species not in the printed table.

ParameterTypeDescription
speciesfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_5_13_MP` (case-insensitive), or any other species name (returns the default).

table_5_15_temperature_effect — Table 5-15: approximate middle-trend relative change (%) in a clear wood mechanical property at -50 degC (-58 degF) and +50 degC (+122 degF), relative to the value at 20 degC (68 degF), for a given moisture condition band (printed p. 5-36).

ParameterTypeDescription
property_namefloatrequiredA property key of `TABLE_5_15_TEMPERATURE_EFFECT`, e.g. 'moe_parallel', 'bending_strength', 'compressive_strength_parallel'.
moisture_conditionfloatrequiredThe moisture-condition band as printed, e.g. '0', '12', '>fsp', '11-15' (see `TABLE_5_15_TEMPERATURE_EFFECT` keys).

table_5_16_temperature_adjustment — Table 5-16: percentage change in lumber bending properties (MOE, MOR) with change in temperature, via the printed quadratic equation (printed p. 5-37).

ParameterTypeDescription
property_namefloatrequired'moe' or 'mor'.
lumber_gradefloatrequired'all' (MOE) or 'select structural'/'no. 2 or less' (MOR).
moisture_conditionfloatrequired'green_low' (green, lower T range), 'green_high' (green, upper T range, coefficients are 0 -- no significant change), '12', or 'dry' (see `TABLE_5_16_COEFFICIENTS` keys for the valid combination).
temp_ffloatrequiredT, temperature (degrees F). A ValueError is raised if outside the printed [t_min, t_max] range for the selected row.

table_5_3_mechanical_properties — Table 5-3a: clear-wood strength/stiffness properties (metric units), for the module's documented species subset (printed pp. 5-5 to 5-8).

ParameterTypeDescription
speciesfloatrequiredA key of `TABLE_5_3_PROPERTIES` (case-insensitive), e.g. 'douglas-fir, coast', 'pine, loblolly', 'oak, white'.
moisture_conditionfloatoptional'green' or '12' (12% moisture content, default).

dowel_bearing_strength — Eq 8-3: dowel bearing strength Fe (MPa), empirically related to specific gravity (printed p. 8-7). Used for both main-member (Fem) and side-member (Fes) dowel bearing stress in the yield model.

ParameterTypeDescription
specific_gravityfloatrequiredG, ovendry weight and volume basis.

drift_bolt_withdrawal — Eq 8-9: ultimate withdrawal load of a round drift bolt or pin from the side grain of seasoned wood (printed p. 8-10). Average relationship for all species; presumes prebored holes 3.2 mm smaller in diameter than the bolt.

ParameterTypeDescription
specific_gravityfloatrequiredG, specific gravity based on ovendry weight/volume at 12% MC.
diameter_mmfloatrequiredD, drift bolt diameter (mm).
penetration_mmfloatrequiredL, length of penetration of the bolt (mm).

hankinson_bearing_strength — Eq 8-16: the Hankinson formula for bearing strength (or load) of wood at an angle theta to the grain, given the parallel- and perpendicular-to-grain values (printed p. 8-13). Used for bolt/lag- screw bearing at an angle to grain, and generally wherever an angle-to-grain interaction is needed.

ParameterTypeDescription
p_parallelfloatrequiredP, load or stress parallel to the grain.
q_perpendicularfloatrequiredQ, load or stress perpendicular to the grain.
theta_degfloatrequiredtheta, inclination angle from the grain direction (degrees).

lag_screw_lateral_resistance_pre1991 — Eq 8-15: pre-1991 proportional-limit lateral load for a lag screw in the side grain, parallel to the grain, of seasoned wood (printed p. 8-13). Base value assumes side-member thickness 3.5x the shank diameter and main-member penetration 7x (harder woods) to 11x (softer woods) the diameter -- see `TABLE_8_10_THICKNESS_FACTOR for other side-member thicknesses and TABLE_8_11_PERPENDICULAR_FACTOR` for perpendicular-to-grain loading.

ParameterTypeDescription
k_coefficientfloatrequiredK, from Table 8-4 (fastener='lag_screws').
diameter_mmfloatrequiredD, lag screw shank diameter (mm).

lag_screw_withdrawal — Eq 8-14: maximum direct withdrawal load of a lag screw from the side grain of seasoned wood (printed p. 8-12). Developed independently of the wood-screw equation (Eq 8-10) but gives approximately the same results.

ParameterTypeDescription
specific_gravityfloatrequiredG, specific gravity based on ovendry weight/volume at 12% MC.
diameter_mmfloatrequiredD, lag screw shank diameter (mm).
penetration_mmfloatrequiredL, length of penetration of the threaded part (mm).

nail_lateral_resistance_pre1991 — Eq 8-2 (lateral resistance form -- see module docstring's citation note): pre-1991 proportional-limit lateral load for a bright common wire nail driven into the side grain of seasoned wood, at a joint slip of 0.38 mm (printed p. 8-6). Requires penetration >= 10x (dense, G > 0.61) to 14x (G < 0.42) the nail diameter into the member holding the point, and side member thickness about half that penetration.

ParameterTypeDescription
k_coefficientfloatrequiredK, from Table 8-4 (`table_8_4_lateral_load_coefficient`, fastener='nails').
diameter_mmfloatrequiredD, nail diameter (mm).

nail_withdrawal_annularly_threaded — Eq 8-2a: maximum withdrawal load of a bright annularly threaded nail (thread-crest diameter difference > 0.2 mm, thread spacing 1.27-1.96 mm) driven into the side grain of seasoned wood (printed p. 8-4). See module docstring's citation note for the "8-2" label collision with the (unrelated) nail lateral-resistance equation.

ParameterTypeDescription
specific_gravityfloatrequiredG, wood specific gravity based on ovendry weight and ovendry moisture content (Table 5-2 to 5-5).
diameter_mmfloatrequiredD, thread-root shank diameter (mm). Valid only for the threaded portion of the nail.
penetration_mmfloatrequiredL, depth of penetration of the nail in the member holding the point (mm).

nail_withdrawal_common — Eq 8-1: maximum withdrawal load of a bright common wire (smooth shank) nail driven into the side grain of seasoned wood or unseasoned wood that remains wet (printed p. 8-2).

ParameterTypeDescription
specific_gravityfloatrequiredG, wood specific gravity based on ovendry weight and volume at 12% moisture content (Table 5-3).
diameter_mmfloatrequiredD, nail diameter (mm).
penetration_mmfloatrequiredL, depth of penetration of the nail in the member holding the point (mm).

screw_lateral_resistance_pre1991 — Eq 8-13: pre-1991 proportional-limit lateral load for a wood screw in the side grain of seasoned wood (printed p. 8-11). Applies when penetration of the threaded part is >= 7x the shank diameter and side member/main member are of similar density.

ParameterTypeDescription
k_coefficientfloatrequiredK, from Table 8-4 (fastener='screws').
diameter_mmfloatrequiredD, screw shank diameter (mm).

table_8_10_thickness_factor — Table 8-10: multiplication factor for Eq 8-15 lag-screw lateral loads at side-member-thickness/shank-diameter ratios other than 3.5 (printed p. 8-13). Exact printed ratios only (no interpolation).

ParameterTypeDescription
side_member_ratiofloatrequiredRatio of side-member thickness to lag-screw shank diameter (a key of `TABLE_8_10_THICKNESS_FACTOR`: 2.0 to 6.5 in 0.5 steps).

table_8_11_perpendicular_factor — Table 8-11: multiplication factor for Eq 8-15 lag-screw lateral loads applied perpendicular to grain, with the lag screw in the side grain of wood (printed p. 8-13). Exact printed diameters only (no interpolation).

ParameterTypeDescription
shank_diameter_mmfloatrequiredLag screw shank diameter (mm; a key of `TABLE_8_11_PERPENDICULAR_FACTOR`: 4.8 to 25.4 mm).

table_8_1_common_nail_size — Table 8-1: bright common wire nail length/diameter by penny size (printed p. 8-2).

ParameterTypeDescription
penny_sizefloatrequirede.g. '6d', '16d', '60d' (a key of `TABLE_8_1_COMMON_NAILS`).

table_8_4_lateral_load_coefficient — Table 8-4: pre-1991 lateral-load coefficient K (metric), by wood type, specific-gravity range (ovendry weight/volume at 12% MC, tested at 15% MC), and fastener type (printed p. 8-6).

ParameterTypeDescription
wood_typefloatrequired'hardwoods' or 'softwoods'.
specific_gravityfloatrequiredG, used to select the matching printed specific-gravity range.
fastenerfloatoptional'nails' (default, use with Eq 8-2 lateral, p=K*D^1.5), 'screws', or 'lag_screws' (use with Eq 8-13/8-15, p=K*D^2).

table_8_9_screw_shank_diameter — Table 8-9: wood screw shank diameter (mm) by screw gauge number (printed p. 8-12).

ParameterTypeDescription
gaugefloatrequiredScrew number/gauge (a key of `TABLE_8_9_SCREW_SHANK_DIAMETER_MM`).

wood_screw_withdrawal — Eq 8-10: ultimate withdrawal load of a wood screw inserted into the side grain of seasoned wood (printed p. 8-10). Applicable for lead holes ~70% of root diameter (softwoods) / ~90% (hardwoods), and for the screw length/gauge combinations in Table 8-8.

ParameterTypeDescription
specific_gravityfloatrequiredG, specific gravity based on ovendry weight/volume at 12% MC.
diameter_mmfloatrequiredD, screw shank diameter (mm, Table 8-9).
penetration_mmfloatrequiredL, length of penetration of the threaded part of the screw (mm).

yield_limit_lateral_strength — Table 8-5: 5% offset lateral yield strength Z for a two-member dowel-type fastener joint (nail, spike, or screw), by governing yield mode (printed p. 8-7). The yield model theory applies generally to dowel fasteners (nails, screws, bolts, lag screws); the main- and side-member dowel bearing strengths (Fem, Fes) are found from specific gravity via `dowel_bearing_strength` (Eq 8-3).

ParameterTypeDescription
fastener_typefloatrequired'nail' (includes Mode IIIm) or 'screw' (Mode IIIm not applicable).
diameter_mmfloatrequiredD. For annularly threaded nails, thread-root diameter; for screws, shank diameter (or root diameter if the threaded portion is in the shear plane).
fem_mpafloatrequiredDowel bearing stress of the main member (member holding the point), MPa (`dowel_bearing_strength`).
fes_mpafloatrequiredDowel bearing stress of the side member, MPa.
fyb_mpafloatrequiredBending yield stress of the fastener, MPa (ASTM F1575; typically 551-689 MPa for common nails).
side_member_thickness_mmfloatoptionalts. Required for modes Is and IIIs/IV.
main_member_penetration_mmfloatoptionalp, penetration of the nail/spike point in the main member. Required for mode IIIm (nails only).

angle_of_twist — Eq 9-9: angle of twist of a wood member about its longitudinal axis (printed p. 9-5).

ParameterTypeDescription
torquefloatrequiredT, applied torque.
lengthfloatrequiredL, member length.
shear_modulusfloatrequiredG, shear modulus (use sqrt(G_LR*G_LT), or approximate G by E_L/16 if measured G is not available).
torsional_constantfloatrequiredK, torsional constant dependent on cross-sectional shape (Eq 9-10 circular, Eq 9-11 rectangular).

axial_deformation — Eq 9-1: change of length of an axially loaded member (printed p. 9-2).

ParameterTypeDescription
axial_forcefloatrequiredP, axial force parallel to the member axis (positive = tension).
lengthfloatrequiredL, initial length.
areafloatrequiredA, cross-sectional area.
modulus_of_elasticityfloatrequiredE, modulus of elasticity (E_L when grain runs parallel to the member axis).

combined_bending_axial_deflection — Eq 9-7: midspan deflection of a pin-ended (simply supported) member under combined transverse bending load and concentric axial load (printed p. 9-5).

ParameterTypeDescription
delta_0floatrequiredBeam midspan deflection without axial load.
axial_loadfloatrequiredP, axial load (magnitude).
p_criticalfloatrequiredPcr, buckling load of the beam under axial compressive load only (`structural_stability.euler_critical_stress` x area, or the governing column buckling load).
is_tensionfloatrequiredTrue if the axial load is tension (uses '+'), False if compression (uses '-'; P must be < Pcr to avoid collapse).

eccentric_axial_bending_deflection — Eq 9-8: bending deflection at midspan induced by an eccentrically applied axial load on a simply supported, pin-ended member (printed p. 9-5).

ParameterTypeDescription
eccentricityfloatrequirede0, eccentricity of P from the centroidal neutral axis.
axial_loadfloatrequiredP, axial load (magnitude).
p_criticalfloatrequiredPcr, buckling load of the beam under axial compressive load only.
is_tensionfloatrequiredTrue for tension ('+'), False for compression ('-').

ponding_deflection_amplification — Eq 9-6: total elastic deflection due to design load plus ponded water (printed p. 9-5, Zahn).

ParameterTypeDescription
delta_0floatrequiredDeflection due to design load alone.
beam_spacingfloatrequireds, beam spacing.
critical_spacingfloatrequireds_cr, critical beam spacing (Eq 9-32, `structural_stability.critical_ponding_spacing`).

section_modified_shear_area — Eq 9-4: modified area A' for shear deflection (printed p. 9-3).

ParameterTypeDescription
shapefloatrequired'rectangular' or 'circular'.
b_or_dfloatrequiredBeam width b (rectangular) or diameter d (circular).
hfloatoptionalBeam depth (rectangular only; required if shape='rectangular').

section_moment_of_inertia — Eq 9-3: moment of inertia I about the centroidal axis (printed p. 9-3).

ParameterTypeDescription
shapefloatrequired'rectangular' or 'circular'.
b_or_dfloatrequiredBeam width b (rectangular) or diameter d (circular).
hfloatoptionalBeam depth (rectangular only; required if shape='rectangular').

straight_beam_deflection — Eq 9-2: deflection of a straight, elastically stressed beam of constant cross section (printed p. 9-2), as the sum of bending and shear deflection.

ParameterTypeDescription
kbfloatrequired
ksfloatrequired
w_totalfloatrequiredW, total beam load acting perpendicular to the beam neutral axis.
lengthfloatrequiredL, beam span.
moment_of_inertiafloatrequiredI, beam moment of inertia (Eq 9-3).
modified_areafloatrequiredA', modified beam area for shear (Eq 9-4).
modulus_of_elasticityfloatrequiredE, beam modulus of elasticity (E_L for grain parallel to axis).
shear_modulusfloatrequiredG, beam shear modulus (G_LT for flat-grained vertical faces, G_LR for edge-grained vertical faces).

table_9_1_kb_ks — Table 9-1: kb/ks deflection constants by loading and support condition, for use in `straight_beam_deflection` (Eq 9-2) (printed p. 9-3).

ParameterTypeDescription
loadingfloatrequired'uniformly_distributed', 'concentrated_midspan', 'concentrated_quarter_points' (two loads at the outer quarter-span points), or 'concentrated_free_end' (cantilever only).
supportfloatrequired'simply_supported', 'clamped' (both ends), or 'cantilever' (one free, one clamped).

tapered_beam_shear_deflection — Eq 9-5: shear deflection of a single- or double-tapered beam (printed p. 9-4, Maki and Kuenzi 1965). Total deflection = this shear term plus the bending deflection (read from Figs. 9-4/9-5 for tapered beams).

ParameterTypeDescription
loadfloatrequiredW (total, uniformly distributed) or P (concentrated at midspan).
lengthfloatrequiredL, beam span.
shear_modulusfloatrequiredG, beam shear modulus.
bfloatrequiredBeam width.
h0floatrequiredDepth of the beam at the shallow end (minimum depth).
loadingfloatoptional'uniform' (default) or 'concentrated_midspan'.

torsional_constant_circular — Eq 9-10: torsional constant K for a circular cross section, equal to the polar moment of inertia J (printed p. 9-6).

ParameterTypeDescription
diameterfloatrequiredD, member diameter.

torsional_constant_rectangular — Eq 9-11: approximate torsional constant K (second polar moment of inertia J) for a rectangular cross section (printed p. 9-6, Trayer and March 1930).

ParameterTypeDescription
hfloatrequiredLarger cross-section dimension.
bfloatrequiredSmaller cross-section dimension (b <= h).

axial_stress — Eq 9-12: uniform axial stress from a concentric axial load (printed p. 9-6). Tension positive (ft = +P/A); the same equation applies to short-block compression with a negative sign convention (fc = -P/A, valid while the member is short enough to fail by fiber crushing without buckling).

ParameterTypeDescription
axial_loadfloatrequiredP, axial load (positive = tension, negative = compression, per the caller's sign convention).
areafloatrequiredA, cross-sectional area.

beam_shear_stress — Eq 9-14: maximum shear stress acting on a beam cross section of uniform, solid section, at the neutral axis (printed p. 9-8).

ParameterTypeDescription
shear_forcefloatrequiredV, vertical shear force on the cross section.
areafloatrequiredA, cross-sectional area.
shapefloatoptional'rectangular' (default, k=3/2) or 'circular' (k=4/3).

bending_stress — Eq 9-13: maximum bending stress at the extreme top/bottom fibers of a beam cross section (printed p. 9-7). Also used beyond the limits of Hooke's law with M as the ultimate moment at failure, giving the "modulus of rupture" (Table 5-3 values).

ParameterTypeDescription
momentfloatrequiredM, bending moment.
section_modulus_valuefloatrequiredS (`section_modulus`).

combined_bending_axial_stress — Eq 9-22: net bending stress from combined bending and concentric axial load, on a simply supported, pin-ended beam (printed p. 9-12). Total stress is by superposition of this with Eq 9-12 (fb + P/A).

ParameterTypeDescription
fb0floatrequiredBending stress without axial load.
axial_loadfloatrequiredP, axial load (magnitude).
areafloatrequiredA, cross-sectional area.
p_criticalfloatrequiredPcr, buckling load of the beam under axial compression alone.
is_tensionfloatrequiredTrue for tension ('+'), False for compression ('-'; check P < Pcr and possible buckling under combined loading, Eq 9-36).

crack_initiation_check — Eq 9-21: conservative fracture-mechanics criterion for crack initiation at a beam slit/notch (printed p. 9-12, after Murphy 1979).

ParameterTypeDescription
hfloatrequiredBeam depth.
bfloatrequiredBeam width.
momentfloatrequiredM, bending moment.
shear_forcefloatrequiredV, vertical shear force.
a_coefficientfloatrequired
b_coefficientfloatrequired

eccentric_bending_axial_stress — Printed p. 9-12: maximum tensile/compressive stresses under an eccentrically applied axial load added to transverse bending (fb0 tensile on the convex edge, compressive on the concave edge). The bending stress fb0 is augmented by +/- P*e0/S before applying the Eq 9-22 amplification.

ParameterTypeDescription
fb0floatrequiredBending stress without axial load (tensile on convex edge).
eccentricityfloatrequirede0, eccentricity of the axial load from the centroidal axis (negative if applied to create convex curvature opposite Fig 9-7).
section_modulus_valuefloatrequiredS (`section_modulus`).
axial_loadfloatrequiredP, axial load (magnitude).
areafloatrequiredA, cross-sectional area.
p_criticalfloatrequiredPcr, buckling load under axial compression alone.
is_tensionfloatrequiredTrue for tension, False for compression.

figure_9_14_coefficients — Figure 9-14: coefficients A (tension- or compression-edge slit) and B for the crack-initiation criterion (Eq 9-21), by slit-depth ratio a/h (printed p. 9-12). Linearly interpolated between the printed curve's plotted stations; conservative for most softwood species per the handbook text.

ParameterTypeDescription
a_over_hfloatrequireda/h, slit depth over beam depth (0 to ~0.55, the plotted range).
edgefloatoptional'tension' (default, uses At) or 'compression' (uses Ac).

section_modulus — Elastic section modulus S used in Eq 9-13 (printed p. 9-7): S = b*h^2/6 for rectangular, S = pi*D^3/32 for circular.

ParameterTypeDescription
shapefloatrequired'rectangular' or 'circular'.
b_or_dfloatrequiredBeam width b (rectangular) or diameter D (circular).
hfloatoptionalBeam depth (rectangular only).

shear_strength_size_adjusted — Eq 9-20: beam shear strength adjusted for size and the shear-block re-entrant-corner stress concentration, from ASTM D143 shear block strength (printed p. 9-11, Rammer and Soltis 1994; Rammer and others 1996).

ParameterTypeDescription
cffloatrequiredStress concentration factor for the shear block re-entrant corner (approximately 2).
tau_astmfloatrequiredASTM D143 shear block strength.
areafloatrequiredA, shear area (beam width x length of beam subjected to shear force; cm^2 for metric, in^2 for inch-pound).
unitsfloatoptional'metric' (Eq 9-20a) or 'inch-pound' (Eq 9-20b).

size_effect_midspan_reference — Eq 9-18: modulus of rupture R1 of a beam under two-point (or third-point, etc.) bending, referenced to R2 measured on a beam of depth 50.8 mm (2 in.) and span 711.12 mm (28 in.) loaded at midspan (printed p. 9-10, factored from Eq 9-17 with h2/L2 fixed and a2=0).

ParameterTypeDescription
r2floatrequiredModulus of rupture of the h2=50.8 mm / L2=711.12 mm midspan- loaded reference beam.
h1floatrequired
l1floatrequired
a1floatrequired
mfloatoptionalMaterial constant (default 18).
unitsfloatoptional'metric' (Eq 9-18a, constant 36125, R in MPa) or 'inch-pound' (Eq 9-18b, constant 56, R in lbf/in^2).

size_effect_ratio_two_point_vs_concentrated — Eq 9-17: ratio of modulus of rupture of beam 1 to beam 2, for two beams under two equal concentrated loads placed symmetrically about midspan (weakest-link statistical strength theory) (printed p. 9-10).

ParameterTypeDescription
h1floatrequired
l1floatrequired
a1floatrequired
h2floatrequired
l2floatrequired
a2floatrequired
mfloatoptionalEmpirically determined material constant (default 18, per Bohannan 1966 for clear, straight-grained Douglas-fir).

size_effect_ratio_uniform_vs_concentrated — Eq 9-19: ratio of modulus of rupture of a beam under uniformly distributed load (subscript u) to a beam under two-point concentrated load (subscript c) (printed p. 9-11, Liu 1982).

ParameterTypeDescription
hufloatrequired
lufloatrequired
hcfloatrequired
lcfloatrequired
acfloatrequired
mfloatoptionalMaterial constant (default 18, fixed by fitting Douglas-fir data as printed; the exponent 1/18 in the printed equation is not parameterized independently of m in the source, so m is exposed here only for consistency with Eq 9-17/9-18 -- leave at 18 unless a source-documented alternative is available).

tapered_beam_interaction — Eq 9-15: Norris (1950) interaction criterion for the combined stress state at a tapered beam edge, based on the Henky-von Mises distortion-energy theory (printed p. 9-9).

ParameterTypeDescription
fxfloatrequired
fxyfloatrequired
fyfloatrequired
fx_allowfloatrequired
fxy_allowfloatrequired
fy_allowfloatrequired

tapered_beam_stresses — Eq 9-16: combined stress state (bending fx, shear fxy, perpendicular tension/compression fy) at the tapered edge of a beam of constant width b that tapers in depth at angle theta (printed p. 9-9, valid for taper slopes < 25 degrees).

ParameterTypeDescription
momentfloatrequiredM, bending moment at the cross section of interest.
bfloatrequiredBeam width (constant).
h0floatrequiredBeam depth at the reaction (shallow end).
theta_radfloatrequiredtheta, angle of the tapered beam profile (radians).

torsional_shear_stress_circular — Eq 9-23: shear stress induced by torsion on a circular cross section (printed p. 9-12).

ParameterTypeDescription
torquefloatrequiredT, applied torsional moment.
diameterfloatrequiredd, member diameter.

torsional_shear_stress_rectangular — Eq 9-24: maximum shear stress induced by torsion on a rectangular cross section (printed p. 9-12, Trayer and March 1930).

ParameterTypeDescription
torquefloatrequiredT, applied torsional moment.
hfloatrequiredLarger cross-section dimension.
bfloatrequiredSmaller cross-section dimension (b <= h).

biaxial_beam_column_interaction — Eq 9-36: interaction check for a member under combined axial compression, primary (edgewise) bending moment, and lateral (flatwise) bending moment (printed p. 9-17, Zahn 1986).

ParameterTypeDescription
fcfloatrequiredMember stress in axial compression.
fc_primefloatrequiredFc', compressive strength reduced for member slenderness (Ylinen, `ylinen_buckling_stress` applied to the governing axis).
fb1floatrequiredEdgewise bending stress.
e1_over_d1floatrequirede1/d1, eccentricity ratio for edgewise bending.
theta_c1floatrequiredMoment magnification factor, edgewise (Eq 9-37).
fb1_primefloatrequiredFb1', edgewise bending strength reduced for slenderness.
fb2floatrequiredFlatwise bending stress.
e2_over_d2floatrequirede2/d2, eccentricity ratio for flatwise bending.
theta_c2floatrequiredMoment magnification factor, flatwise (Eq 9-38).
fb2_allowfloatrequiredFb2, flatwise bending strength (design/allowable value).

built_up_column_capacity — Eq 9-30: buckling stress capacity of a built-up column of mechanically connected members (printed p. 9-14), the Ylinen form reduced by a built-up stability factor Kf that accounts for connection efficiency.

ParameterTypeDescription
fcfloatrequiredFc, compressive strength.
fefloatrequiredfe, Euler buckling stress (Eq 9-25) of the built-up section.
cfloatrequiredYlinen constant (see `ylinen_buckling_stress`).
k_ffloatrequiredBuilt-up stability factor (0.75 bolts, 0.6 nails, per the printed guidance).

critical_ponding_spacing — Eq 9-32: critical beam spacing to prevent progressive deflection (ponding failure) under roof water accumulation (printed p. 9-15, Zahn 1988). To prevent ponding, actual beam spacing must be less than s_cr.

ParameterTypeDescription
modulus_of_elasticityfloatrequiredE, beam modulus of elasticity.
moment_of_inertiafloatrequiredI, beam moment of inertia.
lengthfloatrequiredL, beam length.
end_conditionfloatoptional'simple' (default, m=1) or 'fixed' (m=16/3).
rho_waterfloatoptionalDensity of water (kg/m^3, default 1000; printed alternative 0.0361 lb/in^3 for inch-pound units -- pass explicitly if using those).

deck_shear_stiffness_parameter — Eq 9-35: deck shear stiffness parameter tau (Zahn 1973), the abscissa of Figure 9-23 (increase in lateral-torsional buckling stress from an attached deck, simply supported beams only) (printed p. 9-16).

ParameterTypeDescription
beam_spacingfloatrequireds, beam spacing.
deck_shear_rigidityfloatrequiredG_D, in-plane shear rigidity of the deck (shear force per unit length of edge / shear strain).
lengthfloatrequiredL, actual beam length.
ei_yfloatrequiredLateral flexural rigidity (as in Eq 9-34).

elastic_buckling_stress_edgewise_bending — Eq 9-41: elastic lateral (edgewise) bending buckling stress used in the flatwise moment-magnification factor theta_c2 (printed p. 9-17).

ParameterTypeDescription
modulus_of_elasticityfloatrequiredE.
lefloatrequiredEffective length of the member.
d1floatrequiredMember depth for edgewise bending.
d2floatrequiredMember depth for flatwise bending.

elastic_buckling_stress_edgewise_flatwise — Eq 9-39/9-40: elastic (Euler-form) buckling stress for edgewise (subscript 1) or flatwise (subscript 2) bending/compression, used in the biaxial beam-column interaction check (printed p. 9-17).

ParameterTypeDescription
modulus_of_elasticityfloatrequiredE.
lefloatrequiredle1 or le2, effective length for the axis of interest.
dfloatrequiredd1 or d2, member depth for that axis.

euler_critical_stress — Eq 9-25: critical buckling stress of a long column (buckles before the compressive stress P/A exceeds the proportional limit), by Euler's formula (printed p. 9-13).

ParameterTypeDescription
modulus_of_elasticityfloatrequiredE_L, elastic modulus parallel to the member axis.
unbraced_lengthfloatrequiredL, unbraced length.
radius_of_gyration_valuefloatrequiredr, least radius of gyration (Eq 9-26).

flange_instability_stress — Eq 9-31: elastic instability stress of a thin outstanding flange (I, H, +, or L cross sections) (printed p. 9-14, Trayer and March 1931). If joints between column members are glued and reinforced with glued fillets, the instability stress increases to as much as 1.6x this value.

ParameterTypeDescription
modulus_of_elasticityfloatrequiredE, column modulus of elasticity.
flange_thicknessfloatrequiredt, thickness of the outstanding flange.
flange_widthfloatrequiredb, width of the outstanding flange.

lateral_torsional_buckling_stress — Eq 9-33: critical bending stress at which a long, slender beam (restrained against torsional/axial rotation at supports, otherwise free to twist and deflect laterally) buckles (printed p. 9-15). Valid for bending stresses below the proportional limit.

ParameterTypeDescription
modulus_of_elasticityfloatrequiredE_L, elastic modulus parallel to the member axis.
alphafloatrequiredSlenderness factor (Eq 9-34, `slenderness_factor`).

moment_magnification_edgewise — Eq 9-37: moment magnification factor theta_c1 for edgewise bending (printed p. 9-17).

ParameterTypeDescription
fcfloatrequiredMember compressive stress.
fc1_double_primefloatrequiredFc1'', elastic buckling stress for edgewise compression (Eq 9-39).
beam_spacingfloatrequireds, beam spacing.
s_crfloatrequireds_cr, critical ponding spacing (Eq 9-32).

moment_magnification_flatwise — Eq 9-38: moment magnification factor theta_c2 for flatwise bending (printed p. 9-17).

ParameterTypeDescription
fcfloatrequiredMember compressive stress.
fc2_double_primefloatrequiredFc2'', elastic buckling stress for flatwise compression (Eq 9-40).
fb1floatrequiredEdgewise bending stress.
e1_over_d1floatrequirede1/d1, ratio of eccentricity of axial compression to member depth for edgewise bending.
fb1_double_primefloatrequiredFb1'', elastic lateral (edgewise) bending buckling stress (Eq 9-41).

radius_of_gyration — Eq 9-26: radius of gyration r (printed p. 9-13).

ParameterTypeDescription
shapefloatrequired'general' (requires moment_of_inertia and area), 'rectangular' (requires b), or 'circular' (requires d).
moment_of_inertiafloatoptionalI (shape='general').
areafloatoptionalA (shape='general').
bfloatoptionalLeast cross-section dimension (shape='rectangular').
dfloatoptionalDiameter (shape='circular').

slenderness_factor — Eq 9-34: slenderness factor alpha for lateral-torsional buckling of a rectangular beam (printed p. 9-16).

ParameterTypeDescription
ei_yfloatrequiredLateral flexural rigidity E_L*h*b^3/12.
gjfloatrequiredTorsional rigidity (G times the torsional constant K, Eq 9-9/9-11).
lefloatrequiredLe, effective length (Table 9-2).
hfloatrequiredBeam depth.
bfloatrequiredBeam width.

table_9_2_effective_length — Table 9-2: effective length Le for checking lateral-torsional stability of beams, by support condition and load case (printed p. 9-16). Conservative for beam width/depth ratio < 0.4.

ParameterTypeDescription
supportfloatrequired'simple_support' or 'cantilever'.
loadfloatrequired'equal_end_moments' (simple support only), 'concentrated_center' (simple support) / 'concentrated_end' (cantilever), or 'uniformly_distributed' (either support).
lengthfloatrequiredL, beam span (simple support) or cantilever length.
depthfloatrequiredh, beam depth.

ylinen_buckling_stress — Eq 9-29: Ylinen's short-column buckling equation, using the slope of Eq 9-28 in place of E_L in Euler's formula (printed p. 9-14).

ParameterTypeDescription
fcfloatrequiredFc, compressive strength.
fefloatrequiredfe, Euler buckling stress (Eq 9-25).
cfloatoptionalEmpirical constant (default 0.957; see printed guidance above).

ylinen_critical_stress_fourth_power — Eq 9-27: short-column critical buckling stress, the FPL fourth- power parabolic function of Newlin and Gahagan (1930) (printed p. 9-13).

ParameterTypeDescription
fcfloatrequiredFc, compressive strength (parallel to grain).
unbraced_lengthfloatrequiredL, unbraced length.
radius_of_gyration_valuefloatrequiredr, least radius of gyration.
modulus_of_elasticityfloatrequiredE_L, elastic modulus parallel to the member axis.

ylinen_strain — Eq 9-28: Ylinen (1956) nonlinear compressive stress-strain relationship used in place of Hooke's law for short-column analysis (printed p. 9-14).

ParameterTypeDescription
fcfloatrequiredFc, compressive strength.
stressfloatrequiredf, compressive stress (0 <= f < Fc).
modulus_of_elasticityfloatrequiredE_L.
cfloatrequiredEmpirical constant, 0 < c < 1 (see `ylinen_buckling_stress` for the printed guidance on c).

retrieve_section — Retrieve one section by its ID, at any level: its own text, 'under' (the sections above it) and 'children' (ID and title of each subsection, fetched by its own ID). A missing ID's error names the nearest section above it and the sections numbered under it.

ParameterTypeDescription
section_idstrrequiredSection identifier at any level (e.g. '4-1').
include_subsectionsbooloptionalInline the subsections' text too, when the whole fits in 12,000 characters; otherwise they stay listed in 'children' with a note.

search_sections — Keyword search across every section and subsection, best first: each hit is a section's number, title, chapter, 'under' (the sections above it) and a snippet of its text, never the whole text (retrieve_section fetches that). As many hits as fit; 'next_offset' and a note say how to get more.

ParameterTypeDescription
querystrrequiredSearch query (case-insensitive, multi-word AND).
limitintoptionalMost hits to return (at most 50; fewer when they would not fit).
offsetintoptionalSkip this many of the best hits: the 'next_offset' of the last call.

list_chapters — List chapters and their sections by ID and title, subsections included (a nested one carries parent_id). Without 'chapter': every chapter, with its sections when the whole listing fits one result (otherwise titles and section counts, and a note). With 'chapter': that chapter's sections.

ParameterTypeDescription
chapterintoptionalChapter number: list its sections. Leave out for every chapter.

load_chapter — Load a whole chapter: every section's text. A chapter too long for one result (most are) comes back as its list of sections with a note: fetch the ones you need with retrieve_section.

ParameterTypeDescription
chapterintrequiredChapter number.

10.1.49 worked_examples — worked_examples

find_worked_examples — Search validated worked examples from real published design reports (FHWA GEC, Caltrans, AASHTO, UFC, Slide2/FLAC verification). Returns compact summaries; fetch the full entry with get_worked_example. Consult BEFORE a nontrivial multi-step design or calc report — the entry shows the method calls, parameters, published answer, and what a good report presents.

ParameterTypeDescription
topicstrrequired
domainstroptional
limitintoptional

get_worked_example — Fetch one worked example by id: self-contained problem statement, ready-to-run dispatch calls with parameters, published vs computed results, and report-writing notes.

ParameterTypeDescription
example_idstrrequired
